literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: DENV 和 CHIKV 是非洲之角重要且可能未被充分认识的虫媒病毒威胁,有证据表明 传播 持续存在且广泛暴露。汇集的 DENV 患病率 IgG 为 20%,IgM 为 10%,NS1 为 6%,PCR 为 4%。IgG 的 CHIKV 患病率 为 5%,IgM 的 CHIKV 患病率 为 8%,PCR 为 4%。所有四种 DENV 血清型均在肯尼亚和埃塞俄比亚传播,而 DENV-2 和 DENV-3 则在索马里报告。埃及伊蚊是主要的 媒介。 [10.64898/2026.08.03.26359549]
将建立两个独立的模型:一个预测报告的登革热病例的住院情况,另一个预测住院登革热患者的 死亡率。 [10.64898/2026.08.03.26359583]
DENV-4 感染会导致 DNA 损伤并下调 DNA 修复基因转录,导致持久的生物“疤痕”,从而增加慢性疾病风险。 [10.1073/pnas.2536909123]
与瑞德西韦核苷 (RVn) 相比,V2043 是多种黄病毒的更有效的体外抑制剂,包括登革热病毒、寨卡病毒、西尼罗河病毒和日本脑炎病毒。每日一次口服 V2043 可显着降低小鼠模型中的登革热血清病毒血症、临床严重程度、体重减轻和 死亡率。 [10.1128/aac.00401-26]
综合系统生物学方法将用于在基于机制的预后生物标志物发现中识别与登革热严重程度相关的 宿主 免疫和代谢途径。 [10.1186/s12879-026-14111-x]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: DENV and CHIKV are important and likely underrecognized arboviral threats in the Horn of Africa, with evidence of ongoing transmission and widespread exposure. Pooled DENV prevalence was 20% for IgG, 10% for IgM, 6% for NS1, and 4% by PCR. CHIKV prevalence was 5% for IgG, 8% for IgM, and 4% by PCR. [10.64898/2026.08.03.26359549]
Two independent models will be built: one predicting hospitalization among reported dengue cases and another predicting mortality among hospitalized dengue patients. [10.64898/2026.08.03.26359583]
DENV-4 infection causes DNA damage and downregulates DNA repair gene transcription, leading to durable biological 'scars' that increase chronic disease risk. [10.1073/pnas.2536909123]

V2043 was a more potent in vitro inhibitor of multiple flaviviruses, including dengue, Zika, West Nile, and Japanese encephalitis viruses, compared to remdesivir nucleoside (RVn). Once-daily oral V2043 significantly decreased dengue serum viremia, clinical severity, weight loss, and mortality in mouse models. [10.1128/aac.00401-26]

Integrated systems biology approaches will be used to identify host immune and metabolic pathways associated with dengue severity in a mechanism-based prognostic biomarker discovery. [10.1186/s12879-026-14111-x]

news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 北弗吉尼亚州居民确诊一例本地获得的 登革病毒 感染病例。这是弗吉尼亚州第一例有记录的本地感染登革热病例。该患者在发病前没有已知的弗吉尼亚州以外的旅行经历。 [news-0b105fd470ff1a92]
自 2025 年 1 月 1 日以来,多个太平洋岛屿国家和地区 (PIC) 确诊登革热 暴发,已报告 12 例 暴发。暴发 于 2026 年在新喀里多尼亚、汤加和谢法省(瓦努阿图)正式宣布。截至 2026 年 8 月 3 日,暴发 在瓦努阿图谢法省仍在进行中。 [news-669d6fe44dbbbde6]
弗吉尼亚州卫生官员报告了首例本地感染的 登革病毒 病例,这是一种蚊媒疾病。该事件已得到官方国家报告的证实。 [news-f4b5ace1cd4ccd33]
弗吉尼亚州卫生部 (VDH) 确认该州首例由蚊子传播的本地 登革病毒 病例。 [news-32ce8ecabab38d4c]
VDH(弗吉尼亚州卫生部)正在调查 登革病毒。这是有史以来第一例记录在案的北弗吉尼亚州本地感染该病毒的病例。该事件已得到证实并正在调查中。 [news-06cb54cfff6ea950]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A confirmed case of locally acquired dengue virus infection in a Northern Virginia resident. This is the first documented case of locally acquired dengue in Virginia. The patient had no known travel outside of Virginia prior to illness onset. [news-0b105fd470ff1a92]

Confirmed dengue outbreaks across multiple Pacific Island Countries and Areas (PICs) since 1 January 2025, with 12 outbreaks reported. Outbreaks were officially declared in New Caledonia, Tonga, and Shefa Province (Vanuatu) in 2026. The outbreak remains ongoing in Shefa Province, Vanuatu, as of 3 August 2026. [news-669d6fe44dbbbde6]
Virginia state health officials reported the first locally acquired case of dengue virus, a mosquito-borne illness. The event is confirmed by official state reporting. [news-f4b5ace1cd4ccd33]
Virginia Department of Health (VDH) confirmed the first locally acquired case of dengue virus transmitted by mosquitoes in the state. [news-32ce8ecabab38d4c]

VDH (Virginia Department of Health) is investigating dengue virus. This is the first-ever documented case of the virus being acquired locally in Northern Virginia. The event is confirmed and under investigation. [news-06cb54cfff6ea950]

papers.title: A multicenter prospective observational multi-omics study protocol to identify biomarkers for severe dengue: COMBAT study clinical protocol.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a major global public health burden, particularly in endemic regions where repeated exposure increases the risk of severe disease. Despite revisions to the World Health Organization (WHO) dengue classification, early prediction of progression to severe dengue remains challenging due to overlapping clinical and laboratory features. Current management strategies rely primarily on supportive care and reactive monitoring, underscoring the need for predictive biomarkers that enable early risk stratification and timely intervention. METHODS: COMBAT is a prospective, multicenter, observational longitudinal study conducted in dengue-endemic regions of Guatemala and India. Patients will be classified according to WHO 2009 criteria into dengue without warning signs, dengue with warning signs, and severe dengue, alongside age- and sex-matched healthy controls. A single blood sample will be collected from non-hospitalized patients while two blood samples per participant will be collected during hospitalization and one at discharge. Multi-omics analyses, including transcriptomics, proteomics, glycomics and metabolomics, will be performed in a discovery cohort and validated in an independent cohort. Integrated systems biology approaches will be used to identify host immune and metabolic pathways associated with dengue severity in a mechanism-based prognostic biomarker discovery. DISCUSSION: This study aims to generate comprehensive systems-level insights into host-virus interactions driving dengue severity and to identify biomarkers predictive of disease progression. The findings may inform improved patient triage, early intervention strategies, and the identification of novel therapeutic targets. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID NCT06751836 Registration Date: December 13, 2024, CTRI/2022/10/046293 (MAHE) Registration Date: October 10, 2022.
authors: Matti Christian Soham Gustaf Jose Mukesh Annika Charlott Sällberg Giske Gupta Gustaf Ahlé Inzunza Varshney

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革病毒 (DENV) 感染给全球公共卫生带来了重大负担,特别是在反复接触会增加严重疾病风险的流行地区。尽管世界卫生组织 (WHO) 登革热分类进行了修订,但由于临床和实验室特征重叠,早期预测 重症登革热 的进展仍然具有挑战性。目前的管理策略主要依赖于支持性护理和反应性监测,强调需要能够进行早期风险分层和及时干预的预测性生物标志物。方法:COMBAT 是一项在危地马拉和印度登革热流行地区进行的前瞻性、多中心、观察性纵向研究。根据 WHO 2009 年标准,患者将被分为无预警症状的登革热、有预警症状的登革热和 重症登革热,以及年龄和性别匹配的健康对照。将从非住院患者身上采集一份血液样本,而每个参与者在住院期间采集两份血液样本,在出院时采集一份血液样本。多组学分析,包括转录组学、蛋白质组学、糖组学和代谢组学,将在发现 队列研究 中进行,并在独立的 队列研究 中进行验证。综合系统生物学方法将用于在基于机制的预后生物标志物发现中识别与登革热严重程度相关的 宿主 免疫和代谢途径。讨论:本研究旨在对导致登革热严重程度的 宿主 病毒相互作用产生全面的系统级见解,并确定预测疾病进展的生物标志物。这些发现可能有助于改进患者分诊、早期干预策略以及确定新的治疗靶点。试验注册:ClinicalTrials.gov ID NCT06751836 注册日期:2024 年 12 月 13 日,CTRI/2022/10/046293 (MAHE) 注册日期:2022 年 10 月 10 日。

papers.title: Prevalence of Dengue and Chikungunya in the Horn of Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue virus (DENV) and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are important mosquito-borne arboviruses with expanding global distributions. Although recurrent outbreaks have occurred in the Horn of Africa since the early 2000s, their epidemiology and burden remain poorly characterized. This systematic review and meta-analysis estimated the prevalence of DENV and CHIKV, their distribution by country, diagnostic methods, circulating DENV serotypes, and mosquito vectors. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, SpringerLink, Nature Portfolio, and Google Scholar were searched for studies published up to October 2025. Eligible studies reported DENV and/or CHIKV infections in humans or mosquitoes in Kenya, Ethiopia, or Somalia. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed, with subgroup analyses by country, population, setting, and diagnostic method. Results: Of 3,351 records, 65 studies met the inclusion criteria, most from Kenya (63.1%), followed by Ethiopia (30.8%) and Somalia (6.1%). Pooled DENV prevalence was 20% for IgG, 10% for IgM, 6% for NS1, and 4% by PCR. Corresponding CHIKV prevalence was 5% for IgG, 8% for IgM, and 4% by PCR. Significant differences between countries were observed for DENV NS1 (p<0.0001) and PCR-confirmed infections (p=0.01). DENV prevalence was highest in the general population (16%) compared with febrile patients (6%) and mosquito vectors (1%) (p=0.033), whereas CHIKV prevalence was highest in rural settings (15%) (p=0.0002). All four DENV serotypes circulated in Kenya and Ethiopia, while DENV-2 and DENV-3 were reported in Somalia. Aedes aegypti was the predominant vector, reported in 92.3% of vector studies. Conclusions: DENV and CHIKV are important and likely underrecognized arboviral threats to global public health and in the Horn of Africa, with evidence of ongoing transmission and widespread exposure. Strengthened surveillance, diagnostic capacity, vector control, and regional collaboration are needed to mitigate their growing public health impact.

papers.title_zh: 非洲之角登革热和基孔肯雅热的 患病率:系统回顾和荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue virus (DENV) and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are important mosquito-borne arboviruses with expanding global distributions. Although recurrent outbreaks have occurred in the Horn of Africa since the early 2000s, their epidemiology and burden remain poorly characterized. This systematic review and meta-analysis estimated the prevalence of DENV and CHIKV, their distribution by country, diagnostic methods, circulating DENV serotypes, and mosquito vectors. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, SpringerLink, Nature Portfolio, and Google Scholar were searched for studies published up to October 2025. Eligible studies reported DENV and/or CHIKV infections in humans or mosquitoes in Kenya, Ethiopia, or Somalia. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed, with subgroup analyses by country, population, setting, and diagnostic method. Results: Of 3,351 records, 65 studies met the inclusion criteria, most from Kenya (63.1%), followed by Ethiopia (30.8%) and Somalia (6.1%). Pooled DENV prevalence was 20% for IgG, 10% for IgM, 6% for NS1, and 4% by PCR. Corresponding CHIKV prevalence was 5% for IgG, 8% for IgM, and 4% by PCR. Significant differences between countries were observed for DENV NS1 (p<0.0001) and PCR-confirmed infections (p=0.01). DENV prevalence was highest in the general population (16%) compared with febrile patients (6%) and mosquito vectors (1%) (p=0.033), whereas CHIKV prevalence was highest in rural settings (15%) (p=0.0002). All four DENV serotypes circulated in Kenya and Ethiopia, while DENV-2 and DENV-3 were reported in Somalia. Aedes aegypti was the predominant vector, reported in 92.3% of vector studies. Conclusions: DENV and CHIKV are important and likely underrecognized arboviral threats to global public health and in the Horn of Africa, with evidence of ongoing transmission and widespread exposure. Strengthened surveillance, diagnostic capacity, vector control, and regional collaboration are needed to mitigate their growing public health impact.

papers.title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
papers.abstract: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of <20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

papers.source_body_en: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

papers.title: Oral lipid prodrug V2043 (1- O -octadecyl-2- O -benzyl- sn -glyceryl-P-remdesivir nucleoside) protects mice from lethal dengue infection.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus and related flaviviruses are significant threats to global health, with no approved antiviral treatments available. Remdesivir triphosphate (RVn-TP) is a nucleotide analog that inhibits RNA-dependent RNA polymerases from many clinically important RNA viruses, including dengue virus. An orally bioavailable prodrug that efficiently delivers RVn-TP could facilitate early treatment for non-hospitalized dengue patients. To that end, we developed 1- O -octadecyl-2- O -benzyl- sn -glyceryl-P-remdesivir nucleoside (V2043, ODBG-P-RVn), a phospholipid prodrug that achieves RVn-TP delivery through improved oral bioavailability, potency, and pharmacokinetics. Here, we show that when compared to the parent compound remdesivir nucleoside (RVn), V2043 is a more potent in vitro inhibitor of multiple flaviviruses, including dengue, Zika, West Nile, and Japanese encephalitis viruses. In lethal prophylactic and therapeutic mouse models that recapitulate key aspects of severe dengue in humans, once-daily oral V2043 significantly decreased dengue serum viremia, clinical severity, weight loss, and mortality. Additionally, oral V2043 was well tolerated when administered daily for 14 days. These results demonstrate the potential therapeutic efficacy of V2043 to treat several clinically relevant flaviviruses, including dengue virus, the most prevalent and widespread arbovirus infection in the world.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus and related flaviviruses are significant threats to global health, with no approved antiviral treatments available.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used lethal prophylactic and therapeutic mouse models that recapitulate key aspects of severe dengue in humans.
analysis.methods: An orally bioavailable prodrug, 1-O-octadecyl-2-O-benzyl-sn-glyceryl-P-remdesivir nucleoside (V2043, ODBG-P-RVn), was developed to deliver remdesivir triphosphate (RVn-TP) through improved oral bioavailability, potency, and pharmacokinetics.
analysis.main_results: V2043 was a more potent in vitro inhibitor of multiple flaviviruses, including dengue, Zika, West Nile, and Japanese encephalitis viruses, compared to remdesivir nucleoside (RVn). Once-daily oral V2043 significantly decreased dengue serum viremia, clinical severity, weight loss, and mortality in mouse models.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrate the potential therapeutic efficacy of V2043 to treat several clinically relevant flaviviruses, including dengue virus, the most prevalent and widespread arbovirus infection in the world.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Oral V2043 could facilitate early treatment for non-hospitalized dengue patients, addressing a critical gap in antiviral options for this global health threat.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in mouse models, which may not fully replicate human dengue pathophysiology, but the evidence strength is high due to consistent and significant results across multiple endpoints.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the efficacy of an oral lipid prodrug, V2043, in treating dengue virus infection. The prodrug, designed to improve the oral bioavailability of remdesivir triphosphate, showed potent in vitro inhibition of multiple flaviviruses, including dengue. In lethal mouse models, once-daily oral V2043 significantly reduced dengue viremia, clinical severity, weight loss, and mortality, with good tolerance over 14 days. The findings highlight V2043's potential as a therapeutic option for dengue and other flaviviruses, addressing the critical need for antiviral treatments against these global health threats.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 和相关黄病毒对全球健康构成重大威胁,目前尚无批准的 抗病毒药物 治疗 可用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用致命性预防性和治疗性小鼠模型,概括了 重症登革热 在人类中的关键方面。
elements_zh.methods: 开发了一种口服生物利用度前药 1-O-十八烷基-2-O-苄基-sn-甘油基-P-瑞德西韦核苷(V2043,ODBG-P-RVn),通过改善口服生物利用度、效力和药代动力学来递送瑞德西韦三磷酸盐(RVn-TP)。
elements_zh.main_results: 与瑞德西韦核苷 (RVn) 相比,V2043 是多种黄病毒的更有效的体外抑制剂,包括登革热病毒、寨卡病毒、西尼罗河病毒和日本脑炎病毒。每日一次口服 V2043 可显着降低小鼠模型中的登革热血清病毒血症、临床严重程度、体重减轻和 死亡率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果证明了 V2043 对治疗几种临床相关黄病毒的潜在治疗功效,包括 登革病毒(世界上最流行和最广泛的虫媒病毒感染)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 口服 V2043 可以促进非住院登革热患者的早期 抗病毒药物,解决这一全球健康威胁的 抗病毒药物 选择中的关键差距。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在小鼠模型中进行的,该模型可能无法完全复制人类登革热病理生理学,但由于多个终点的一致且显着的结果,证据强度很高。

papers.title_zh: 口服脂质前药 V2043(1-O-十八烷基-2-O-苄基-sn-甘油基-P-瑞德西韦核苷)可保护小鼠免受致命的登革热感染。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue virus and related flaviviruses are significant threats to global health, with no approved antiviral treatments available. Remdesivir triphosphate (RVn-TP) is a nucleotide analog that inhibits RNA-dependent RNA polymerases from many clinically important RNA viruses, including dengue virus. An orally bioavailable prodrug that efficiently delivers RVn-TP could facilitate early treatment for non-hospitalized dengue patients. To that end, we developed 1- O -octadecyl-2- O -benzyl- sn -glyceryl-P-remdesivir nucleoside (V2043, ODBG-P-RVn), a phospholipid prodrug that achieves RVn-TP delivery through improved oral bioavailability, potency, and pharmacokinetics. Here, we show that when compared to the parent compound remdesivir nucleoside (RVn), V2043 is a more potent in vitro inhibitor of multiple flaviviruses, including dengue, Zika, West Nile, and Japanese encephalitis viruses. In lethal prophylactic and therapeutic mouse models that recapitulate key aspects of severe dengue in humans, once-daily oral V2043 significantly decreased dengue serum viremia, clinical severity, weight loss, and mortality. Additionally, oral V2043 was well tolerated when administered daily for 14 days. These results demonstrate the potential therapeutic efficacy of V2043 to treat several clinically relevant flaviviruses, including dengue virus, the most prevalent and widespread arbovirus infection in the world.

papers.title: Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis in Dengue Fever: An Emerging Clinical Entity
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral disease that presents with a wide range of clinical manifestations, varying from mild febrile illness to severe systemic involvement. Although acute acalculous cholecystitis is classically observed in critically ill patients, it has recently emerged as a notable complication associated with dengue infection. Objective: This study aimed to determine the incidence, clinical characteristics, treatment approaches, and outcomes of patients with acute acalculous cholecystitis secondary to dengue fever. Methods: A retrospective study was carried out in the Critical Care Unit of Dhaka National Medical College Hospital over a 24-month period (August 2023 to July 2025). A total of 222 patients diagnosed with dengue fever confirmed by positive dengue NS1 antigen or IgM antibody tests were included after requiring surgical consultation. Clinical records, laboratory findings, and abdominal ultrasonography reports were reviewed. Acute acalculous cholecystitis was identified based on clinical presentation and sonographic findings. Data were analyzed descriptively and presented in tables and figures. Results: Among the 222 confirmed dengue cases, 62 patients (27.9%) developed acute acalculous cholecystitis. The cohort included 36 males and 26 females. The mean time from fever onset to hospital presentation was 3.7 days (range 3–5 days). The average white blood cell count was 4216 ± 1374.7 /cm3 and the mean platelet count was 23,757 ± 12,440.5 /cm. All patients presented with fever and headache (100%), while myalgia and arthralgia were observed in 90.5% and 89.2% respectively. Nausea and vomiting occurred in 87.8%, and abdominal pain was reported by 34.2%. Skin rash was noted in 11.7% of patients. Ultrasonography revealed gallbladder wall thickening in all 62 cases, pericholecystic fluid in 56 (25.2%), and a positive sonographic Murphy’s sign in 51 (23.0%); no gallstones were detected. Mild to moderate ascites was present in 31 (14.0%) patients, hepatomegaly in 25 (11.3%), splenomegaly in 16 (7.2%), and mild pleural effusion in 24 (10.8%). The mean gallbladder wall thickness measured 6.1 ± 1.5 mm. All patients were successfully managed conservatively, without surgical intervention. Conclusion: Acute acalculous cholecystitis represents an under recognized but significant manifestation of dengue fever. Prompt ultrasonographic evaluation facilitates early detection, and conservative treatment strategies generally lead to favorable outcomes, thereby reducing unnecessary surgical procedures. J Dhaka National Med. 2026; 32 (01): 07-11
papers.journal: Journal of Dhaka National Medical College & Hospital

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines dengue virus (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and dengue fever as the target pathogen and disease, focusing on acute acalculous cholecystitis as an emerging clinical complication in dengue-infected patients. The central question addresses the incidence, clinical characteristics, diagnostic features, and outcomes of acute acalculous cholecystitis secondary to dengue infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a retrospective study conducted in the Critical Care Unit of Dhaka National Medical College Hospital over 24 months (August 2023 to July 2025). It included 222 dengue-confirmed patients (via NS1 antigen or IgM antibody tests) who required surgical consultation. Data were collected from clinical records, laboratory findings, and abdominal ultrasonography reports, with acute acalculous cholecystitis identified based on clinical presentation and sonographic findings. Analysis was descriptive.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Among 222 confirmed dengue cases, 62 patients (27.9%) developed acute acalculous cholecystitis. All cases presented with fever and headache (100%), while myalgia (90.5%) and arthralgia (89.2%) were common. Ultrasonography revealed gallbladder wall thickening in all 62 cases, pericholecystic fluid in 56 (25.2%), and a positive sonographic Murphy’s sign in 51 (23.0%); no gallstones were detected. Conservative management was successful in all patients without surgical intervention.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report the diagnostic criteria used to differentiate dengue-associated acute acalculous cholecystitis from other causes of gallbladder inflammation. It also does not address potential confounding factors such as pre-existing biliary disease or other comorbidities. Additionally, the study lacks a control group of dengue patients without cholecystitis, limiting causal inference.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for standardized diagnostic protocols to identify dengue-associated acute acalculous cholecystitis early, particularly in endemic regions. It suggests that routine ultrasonographic evaluation in dengue patients with abdominal pain may reduce unnecessary surgical interventions. Further research is required to elucidate the pathophysiological mechanisms linking dengue infection to gallbladder inflammation and to validate conservative management strategies across diverse settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将 登革病毒(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)和 登革热 作为目标病原体和疾病,重点关注急性非结石性胆囊炎作为登革热感染患者的一种新出现的临床并发症。中心问题涉及登革热感染继发的急性非结石性胆囊炎的 发病率、临床特征、诊断特征和结果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评价是在达卡国立医学院医院重症监护室进行的一项为期24个月(2023年8月至2025年7月)的回顾性研究。其中包括 222 名需要外科会诊的登革热确诊患者(通过 NS1 抗原或 IgM 抗体检测)。从临床记录、实验室检查结果和腹部超声检查报告中收集数据,根据临床表现和超声检查结果确定急性非结石性胆囊炎。分析是描述性的。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在222例确诊的登革热病例中,62例(27.9%)患者出现急性非结石性胆囊炎。所有病例均出现发热和头痛(100%),常见肌痛(90.5%)和关节痛(89.2%)。超声检查显示胆囊壁增厚,62 例,胆囊周围积液 56 例(25.2%),超声墨菲征阳性 51 例(23.0%);没有检测到胆结石。所有患者的保守治疗均取得成功,无需手术干预。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述没有报告用于区分登革热相关急性非结石性胆囊炎与其他原因引起的胆囊炎症的诊断标准。它也没有解决潜在的混杂因素,例如先前存在的胆道疾病或其他合并症。此外,该研究缺乏无胆囊炎的登革热患者对照组,限制了因果推断。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要制定标准化诊断方案,以便及早发现登革热相关的急性非结石性胆囊炎,特别是在流行地区。这表明对伴有腹痛的登革热患者进行常规超声检查可能会减少不必要的手术干预。需要进一步的研究来阐明登革热感染与胆囊炎症之间的病理生理机制,并验证不同环境下的保守治疗策略。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将 登革病毒(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)和 登革热 作为目标病原体和疾病,重点关注急性非结石性胆囊炎作为登革热感染患者的一种新出现的临床并发症。中心问题涉及登革热感染继发的急性非结石性胆囊炎的 发病率、临床特征、诊断特征和结果。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评价是在达卡国立医学院医院重症监护室进行的一项为期24个月(2023年8月至2025年7月)的回顾性研究。其中包括 222 名需要外科会诊的登革热确诊患者(通过 NS1 抗原或 IgM 抗体检测)。从临床记录、实验室检查结果和腹部超声检查报告中收集数据,根据临床表现和超声检查结果确定急性非结石性胆囊炎。分析是描述性的。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在222例确诊的登革热病例中,62例(27.9%)患者出现急性非结石性胆囊炎。所有病例均出现发热和头痛(100%),常见肌痛(90.5%)和关节痛(89.2%)。超声检查显示胆囊壁增厚,62 例,胆囊周围积液 56 例(25.2%),超声墨菲征阳性 51 例(23.0%);没有检测到胆结石。所有患者的保守治疗均取得成功,无需手术干预。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述没有报告用于区分登革热相关急性非结石性胆囊炎与其他原因引起的胆囊炎症的诊断标准。它也没有解决潜在的混杂因素,例如先前存在的胆道疾病或其他合并症。此外,该研究缺乏无胆囊炎的登革热患者对照组,限制了因果推断。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要制定标准化诊断方案,以便及早发现登革热相关的急性非结石性胆囊炎,特别是在流行地区。这表明对伴有腹痛的登革热患者进行常规超声检查可能会减少不必要的手术干预。需要进一步的研究来阐明登革热感染与胆囊炎症之间的病理生理机制,并验证不同环境下的保守治疗策略。

papers.title: A spatiotemporal U-Net++ deep learning framework for dengue risk mapping in Colombia
papers.abstract: Abstract Understanding dengue dynamics from a spatiotemporal perspective has become increasingly relevant in recent years, as it allows the identification of factors influencing disease transmission, including climatic conditions, human behavior, and the distribution of Aedes aegypti , the primary vector responsible for dengue virus transmission in tropical and subtropical regions. This knowledge is essential for supporting public health decision-making and reducing the impact of dengue on vulnerable populations. This study proposes a spatio-temporal deep learning framework based on the U-Net++ architecture to generate high-resolution dengue risk maps in Colombia. The model integrates climatic, environmental, demographic, and socioeconomic information derived from satellite and census sources. Two spatial approaches were evaluated: a high-dimensional geography ( HDG ) approach at the national scale and a low-dimensional geography ( LDG ) approach applied to five departments with high dengue incidence. The model integrating climatic, social, and environmental information achieved the best performance in both approaches. In the HDG configuration, the best model (M9) reached a test mIoU of 0.6646 (validation mIoU = 0.7361). In the LDG configuration, the corresponding model achieved an average test mIoU of approximately 0.73 across departments. These results highlight the potential of integrating heterogeneous climatic, environmental, and socioeconomic data within a spatiotemporal deep learning framework to characterize dengue risk patterns and support high-resolution surveillance.

papers.title: Establishment of germline-encoded antibodies during primary dengue infection.
papers.abstract: Dengue viruses impose a major global health burden, while imperfect vaccines raise concerns that the immunization of dengue-naïve individuals may exacerbate disease through immunopathologic mechanisms. Using a controlled human challenge model of primary DENV1 infection, we longitudinally profile B cell receptor repertoires in 9 flavivirus-naïve participants. Despite serological features of primary infection, acute responses are dominated by memory-derived clones in 4/9 participants. We also identify public convergent clones from naive B cells that share sequence features across 7 participants and are enriched for tyrosine-rich CDRH3 motifs. 28 days post infection, these class-switched IgG clones remain relatively germline-like in all participants carrying these public lineages, consistent with early class-switched output before germinal center maturation or a GC-independent pathway. These findings refine models of early antibody responses in dengue and identify germline-like public BCR lineages, including motifs linked to DENV-binding non-neutralizing antibodies, whose specificity and functional role warrant further study.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal co-circulation of four dengue serotypes across Mexico, 2020-2025: A space-time scan analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mexico has experienced escalating dengue transmission driven by the co‐circulation of four antigenically distinct serotypes (DENV‐1 through DENV‐4). Multi‐serotype transmission is epidemiologically relevant, yet its spatiotemporal patterns at sub‐national resolution remain poorly characterized. METHODS: We analyzed 103,426 PCR‐confirmed, serotyped dengue cases across 1,547 of 2,471 Mexican municipalities from January 2020 to December 2025. Kulldorff's space‐time scan statistic under a discrete Poisson model was applied independently to each serotype and to all serotypes combined. Co‐circulation was defined as the spatiotemporal overlap of significant clusters from at least two serotypes within the same municipality for ≥ 1 epidemiological week. RESULTS: We identified 159 statistically significant clusters across all serotypes combined. DENV‐3 was dominant (64.4% of cases; annual incidence 59.9/100,000), consistent with the reemergence of a long‐absent serotype. The 2024-2025 season produced a nationally synchronized epidemic across geographically distant regions. Co‐circulation of at least two serotypes occurred in 1,545 municipalities; 217 experienced simultaneous clustering of all four serotypes. Active co‐circulation was present in 275 of 311 study weeks. Mean pairwise temporal overlap ranged from 8.0 to 12.0 weeks, with maximum overlaps of 29-30 weeks. CONCLUSIONS: Four‐serotype co‐circulation was documented at municipal resolution, concentrated in the Gulf coast, the Yucatán Peninsula, and northeastern Mexico. The 217 municipalities with simultaneous clustering of all four serotypes may represent areas of epidemiological interest for further investigation. This municipality‐level spatiotemporal framework offers operationally relevant resolution for tracking multi‐serotype activity and supporting serotype‐aware dengue monitoring at sub‐national scale.

papers.title: Repurposing drugs for treating dengue haemorrhagic fever and associated autoimmune diseases
papers.abstract: Dengue viruses (DENVs) usually cause a mild febrile illness which might flare up in some patients as dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) or dengue shock syndrome. Altered expression of autoimmune markers and development of autoimmune diseases was observed in patients exhibiting prolonged dengue symptoms, suggesting a possible correlation between DENVs and autoimmune diseases. Molecular mimicry of the blood coagulation pathway proteins by DENVs might be a potential factor underlying clinical manifestations of DHF. Inhibition of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) in DENV mimicry proteins and human proteins can potentially treat both DHF and, associated autoimmune diseases. In this study, we have performed a systematic in silico analysis of human proteins interacting with DENV mimicry proteins (HPIDMP) as novel drug targets. Potential inhibitors of the HPIDMP were discerned from the DrugBank database following stringent parameters. The protein-ligand interactions were predicted using molecular docking and evaluated with decoy-based validation, molecular dynamics simulations, and MM-PBSA binding free energy calculations. RAF1 targeting drugs Sorafenib and Regorafenib exhibited the most consistent interaction profile across all computational analyses, followed by the SIRT1-targeting compounds selisistat and resveratrol, which demonstrated moderate but consistent computational support. In contrast, the MYH9-artenimol and HSPE1-phenethyl isothiocyanate systems showed comparatively weaker support. On the basis of our results, we propose Sorafenib and Regorafenib as the most promising candidates for in vitro or clinical studies for treatment of DHF and/or DENV-associated autoimmune diseases, followed by Selisistat and Resveratrol. Thus these DrugBank molecules can be incorporated in clinical studies or in vitro testing for treatment of DHF and/or DENV-associated autoimmune diseases. Also, the methods adopted in this study can guide the repurposing of known drugs to treat other pathogen-associated autoimmune diseases. Graphical abstract Supplementary information The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s40203-026-00699-0.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 通常会引起轻微的发热性疾病,某些患者可能会突然出现登革出血热 (DHF) 或登革休克综合征。在表现出长期登革热症状的患者中观察到自身免疫标志物表达的改变和自身免疫性疾病的发展,这表明登革病毒和自身免疫性疾病之间可能存在相关性。DENV 对凝血途径蛋白的分子模拟可能是 DHF 临床表现的潜在因素。抑制 DENV 拟态蛋白和人类蛋白中的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 可以潜在地治疗 DHF 和相关的自身免疫性疾病。在这项研究中,我们对与 DENV 拟态蛋白 (HPIDMP) 相互作用的人类蛋白质作为新的药物靶点进行了系统的计算机分析。HPIDMP 的潜在抑制剂是按照严格的参数从 DrugBank 数据库中识别出来的。使用分子对接预测蛋白质-配体相互作用,并通过基于诱饵的验证、分子动力学模拟和 MM-PBSA 结合自由能计算进行评估。RAF1 靶向药物索拉非尼和瑞戈非尼在所有计算分析中表现出最一致的相互作用特征,其次是 SIRT1 靶向化合物 selisistat 和白藜芦醇,它们表现出中等但一致的计算支持。相比之下,MYH9-青蒿醇和HSPE1-异硫氰酸苯乙酯系统显示出相对较弱的支持。根据我们的结果,我们建议索拉非尼和瑞戈非尼作为 DHF 和/或 DENV 相关自身免疫性疾病 治疗 体外或临床研究最有希望的候选药物,其次是 Selisistat 和白藜芦醇。因此,这些 DrugBank 分子可以纳入 DHF 和/或 DENV 相关自身免疫性疾病的 治疗 的临床研究或体外测试中。此外,本研究中采用的方法可以指导已知药物的重新利用,以治疗其他病原体相关的自身免疫性疾病。图解摘要 补充信息 在线版本包含可在 10.1007/s40203-026-00699-0 获取的补充材料。

papers.title: Predictive models for hospitalization and mortality in dengue using SINAN data: study protocol for development, temporal validation, and performance evaluation
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue continues to place a heavy clinical and organizational burden on health care systems, particularly during epidemics, when the high volume of cases adds pressure on triage, decisions regarding hospitalization, and the monitoring of patients at higher risk of severe outcomes. Despite the growing body of literature on dengue prediction, many studies still exhibit heterogeneity in outcomes, insufficiently detailed analytical designs, and a lack of validation. Objective: To describe the protocol for a study on the development and validation of predictive models for the outcomes of hospitalization among reported cases and mortality among hospitalized patients. Methods: A retrospective study will be conducted using secondary data from the Brazilian Notifiable Diseases Information System (SINAN), covering the period from 2017 to 2025. We will build two independent models: one to predict hospitalization among reported dengue cases and another to predict mortality among patients hospitalized for dengue. The protocol will follow TRIPOD+AI guidelines and include prior definition of eligible predictors, restriction to variables available at the clinically appropriate time of decision-making, handling of missing data, comparison between regression and machine learning algorithms, internal and temporal validation, and assessment of discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility. Conclusion: The study aims to establish a transparent and reproducible analytical protocol to support the development of risk models that could be applied to clinical screening and surveillance for dengue.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热继续给卫生保健系统带来沉重的临床和组织负担,特别是在流行期间,大量病例增加了分诊、住院决策以及对严重后果风险较高患者的监测的压力。尽管有关登革热预测的文献越来越多,但许多研究仍然表现出结果的异质性、分析设计不够详细以及缺乏验证。目的:描述报告病例住院结果和住院患者 死亡率 预测模型的开发和验证研究方案。方法:将使用巴西法定疾病信息系统 (SINAN) 的二手数据进行一项回顾性研究,涵盖 2017 年至 2025 年期间。我们将建立两个独立的模型:一个用于预测报告的登革热病例的住院情况,另一个用于预测因登革热住院患者的 死亡率。该协议将遵循 TRIPOD+AI 指南,包括合格预测因子的事先定义、对临床适当决策时间可用变量的限制、缺失数据的处理、回归和机器学习算法之间的比较、内部和时间验证以及歧视、校准和临床效用的评估。结论:该研究旨在建立透明且可重复的分析方案,以支持可应用于登革热临床筛查和 监测 的风险模型的开发。

papers.title: DENV-4 infection suppresses transcription of DNA repair genes
papers.abstract: The molecular mechanisms behind Dengue virus-dependent host pathogenesis, especially genome instability, remain largely unclear. This RNA virus causes a debilitating disease during active infection and presents future risks of postdengue syndromes, leukemia, and DNA damage in the blood cells of infected patients, with the underlying mechanisms unknown. In this study, we show that DENV-4 infection induces significant DNA damage and suppresses the transcription of genes involved in DNA repair and select mutagenic translesion synthesis (TLS) polymerases, indicating that DENV-4-dependent pathobiology leaves durable biological “scars” that incrementally increase chronic disease risk, including carcinogenesis and postdengue syndromes.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

papers.title: Genomic and Epidemiological Characterization of DENV-1 and DENV-2 Co-Circulation During the 2023-2024 Dengue Epidemic in Espírito Santo, Brazil.
papers.abstract: In 2023 and 2024, Espírito Santo state, Brazil, experienced its largest dengue epidemic in 30 years, with record numbers of cases and deaths. This study aimed to characterize confirmed dengue cases and the dengue virus (DENV) during the epidemic and pre-epidemic periods. A population-based descriptive study integrated with cross-sectional genomic sampling was conducted using data from the eSUS Health Surveillance System (2020-2024) and molecular analysis of serum samples (2023-2024). Whole 26 DENV genomes were obtained and combined with public data for phylogenetic reconstruction. In 2023, 127 070 dengue cases were reported; 2.8% showed warning signs or severe dengue, 2.6% required hospitalization, and 99 cases resulted in death. In 2024, 131 170 cases were reported, with 2.0% showing warning signs or severe dengue, 2.3% requiring hospitalization, and 42 fatalities. Four lineages were detected: DENV-1 genotype V lineages 1V_A and 1V_E.1, DENV-2 genotype II lineage 2II_F.1.1.2, and genotype III lineage 2III_C.1.1. These lineages were closely related to viruses from other regions in Brazil and South America. Our findings highlight the complex dynamics of DENV in Espírito Santo state and hypothesize that the multiple introduced DENV lineages and genetic diversity may have contributed to the magnitude and sustained transmission observed over consecutive years.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2023年和2024年,巴西圣埃斯皮里图州经历了30年来最大规模的登革热疫情,病例数和死亡人数创历史新高。本研究旨在描述流行期间和流行前时期确诊的登革热病例和 登革病毒 (DENV) 的特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 eSUS Health 监测 系统(2020-2024 年)的数据和血清样本的分子分析(2023-2024 年)进行了一项基于人群的描述性研究,与横截面基因组采样相结合。
elements_zh.methods: 获得完整的26个DENV 基因组并结合公开数据进行系统发育重建。
elements_zh.main_results: 2023年,报告了127,070例登革热病例;2.8%出现警告症状或重症登革热,2.6%需要住院治疗,99例导致死亡。2024 年,报告了 131,170 例病例,其中 2.0% 出现警告信号或 重症登革热,2.3% 需要住院治疗,42 人死亡。检测到四个谱系:DENV-1基因型V谱系1V_A和1V_E.1、DENV-2基因型II谱系2II_F.1.1.2和基因型III谱系2III_C.1.1。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果强调了圣埃斯皮里图州 DENV 的复杂动态,并假设多种引入的 DENV 谱系和遗传多样性可能导致了连续几年观察到的 传播 的规模和持续。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 流行的 DENV 谱系及其遗传多样性的特征为 监测、暴发 预测以及圣埃斯皮里图州和类似地区的有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供了重要见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的优势在于它将基于人群的数据与基因组分析相结合,尽管测序的样本量(26 基因组)可能会限制谱系多样性研究结果的普遍性。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果强调了圣埃斯皮里图州 DENV 的复杂动态,并假设多种引入的 DENV 谱系和遗传多样性可能导致了连续几年观察到的 传播 的规模和持续。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 流行的 DENV 谱系及其遗传多样性的特征为 监测、暴发 预测以及圣埃斯皮里图州和类似地区的有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供了重要见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的优势在于它将基于人群的数据与基因组分析相结合,尽管测序的样本量(26 基因组)可能会限制谱系多样性研究结果的普遍性。

papers.title: Epidemiological Trends and Seasonal Patterns of Dengue Virus Infection in a Tertiary Care Centre in Warangal Telangana from 2022 to 2025
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is a significant public health issue in tropical and subtropical areas, with rising incidence attributed to rapid urbanization, climate change, and the proliferation of Aedes mosquito vectors. Understanding local epidemiological and seasonal patterns is crucial for implementing effective surveillance and control measures. This study sought to assess the epidemiological characteristics and seasonal trends of laboratory-confirmed dengue infections at a tertiary care center in Warangal, Telangana, over a four-year period from 2022 to 2025. Material and Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases diagnosed between January 2022 and December 2025. The National Institute of Virology, Pune, provided ELISA kits to test serum samples for dengue IgM antibodies. Descriptive statistics were employed to analyze seasonal trends, annual and monthly case distributions, and demographic characteristics. The Chi-square test was employed to compare categorical variables, with statistical significance defined as p Results: During the study period, 3,484 laboratory-confirmed cases of dengue were found. The peak incidence occurred in 2023 (1,091; 31.31%), followed by 2024 (956; 27.44%), 2022 (723; 20.75%), and 2025 (714; 20.49%), indicating a cyclical epidemic trend. A significant seasonal concentration was noted from August to November, comprising 73.45% of all cases, with September exhibiting the peak monthly incidence (923 cases; 26.49%) (χ2 = 484.40, p Conclusion: Dengue transmission in Warangal exhibits a significant burden among pediatric populations and a pronounced post-monsoon seasonal pattern. The significance of enhancing pre-monsoon vector control, early surveillance, and preparedness of healthcare facilities is underscored by the cyclical nature of epidemics and the concentration of cases during August–November. The reduction of dengue-related morbidity and the enhancement of regional public health outcomes can be substantially facilitated by targeted interventions that concentrate on children and continuous epidemiological monitoring.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus infection is a growing public health problem in tropical and subtropical regions due to factors such as urbanization, climate change, and Aedes mosquito proliferation. The study aimed to determine local epidemiological characteristics and seasonal trends of laboratory-confirmed dengue infections to inform surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective observational study analyzed laboratory-confirmed dengue cases diagnosed between January 2022 and December 2025 at a tertiary care center in Warangal, Telangana. Descriptive statistics were used to examine seasonal trends, annual and monthly case distributions, and demographic characteristics.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were tested for dengue IgM antibodies using ELISA kits provided by the National Institute of Virology, Pune. The Chi-square test was employed to compare categorical variables, with statistical significance defined as p < 0.05.
analysis.main_results: A total of 3,484 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases were identified, with peak incidence in 2023 (1,091 cases; 31.31%), followed by 2024 (956 cases; 27.44%), 2022 (723 cases; 20.75%), and 2025 (714 cases; 20.49%). A significant seasonal concentration occurred from August to November, comprising 73.45% of all cases, with September having the highest monthly incidence (923 cases; 26.49%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight a cyclical epidemic trend and a pronounced post-monsoon seasonal pattern in Warangal, with a significant burden among pediatric populations. The study underscores the need for targeted interventions and continuous epidemiological monitoring.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results support enhancing pre-monsoon vector control, early surveillance, and healthcare facility preparedness to reduce dengue-related morbidity and improve regional public health outcomes, particularly through interventions focused on children.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design, reliance on IgM ELISA testing which may have lower specificity, and lack of serotype or severity stratification. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the absence of detailed demographic or clinical outcome data.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective observational study analyzed 3,484 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in Warangal, Telangana, from 2022 to 2025 to characterize epidemiological and seasonal trends. Using ELISA for IgM detection and Chi-square tests for comparisons, the study found a cyclical epidemic pattern with peak incidence in 2023 and a pronounced post-monsoon concentration of cases from August to November, peaking in September. The findings highlight a significant burden among pediatric populations and support targeted pre-monsoon vector control, early surveillance, and healthcare preparedness to reduce dengue-related morbidity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于城市化、气候变化和伊蚊扩散等因素,登革病毒 感染是热带和亚热带地区日益严重的公共卫生问题。该研究旨在确定实验室确诊的登革热感染的当地流行病学特征和季节性趋势,为监测和控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性观察研究分析了 2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间在特伦甘纳邦瓦朗加尔的三级护理中心诊断的实验室确诊登革热病例。描述性统计用于检查季节性趋势、年度和每月病例分布以及人口特征。
elements_zh.methods: 使用浦那国家病毒学研究所提供的 ELISA 试剂盒测试血清样本中的登革热 IgM 抗体。采用卡方检验来比较分类变量,统计显着性定义为 p < 0.05。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了瓦朗加尔的周期性流行趋势和明显的季风后季节性模式,给儿科人群带来了巨大负担。该研究强调需要有针对性的干预措施和持续的流行病学监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持加强季风前 媒介 控制、早期 监测 和医疗机构的准备工作,以减少登革热相关发病率并改善区域公共卫生结果,特别是通过针对儿童的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计、依赖于特异性较低的 IgM ELISA 检测以及缺乏血清型或严重程度分层。由于这些限制以及缺乏详细的人口统计或临床结果数据,证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于城市化、气候变化和伊蚊扩散等因素,登革病毒 感染是热带和亚热带地区日益严重的公共卫生问题。该研究旨在确定实验室确诊的登革热感染的当地流行病学特征和季节性趋势,为监测和控制策略提供信息。

analysis_zh.methods: 使用浦那国家病毒学研究所提供的 ELISA 试剂盒测试血清样本中的登革热 IgM 抗体。采用卡方检验来比较分类变量,统计显着性定义为 p < 0.05。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了瓦朗加尔的周期性流行趋势和明显的季风后季节性模式,给儿科人群带来了巨大负担。该研究强调需要有针对性的干预措施和持续的流行病学监测。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持加强季风前 媒介 控制、早期 监测 和医疗机构的准备工作,以减少登革热相关发病率并改善区域公共卫生结果,特别是通过针对儿童的干预措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计、依赖于特异性较低的 IgM ELISA 检测以及缺乏血清型或严重程度分层。由于这些限制以及缺乏详细的人口统计或临床结果数据,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Population bottlenecks and temporal constraints shape dengue virus infection of Aedes aegypti midguts
papers.abstract: Arthropod-borne viruses (arboviruses) such as dengue virus pose a significant and growing threat to human health worldwide. Maintained in a transmission cycle between arthropod vectors and vertebrate hosts, arboviruses experience strong bottlenecks during transmission which can drastically alter virus population composition and fitness. In vectors, severe population bottlenecks occur at the initial site of infection, the midgut, yet the specific factors driving this process remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we need a better understanding of early infection events; however, traditional detection methods lack the necessary sensitivity. Recent advances in molecular signal amplification-based methods now make it possible to study these early stages in detail. In this study, we examined early dengue virus 2 (DENV-2) infection of Ae. aegypti midguts using multiple hybridization chain reaction techniques. We demonstrate that these techniques are much more sensitive than the traditional immunofluorescence assay and can reliably detect DENV-2 in mosquito midguts as early as 6 hours post infection. Further, we observed significant bottlenecks as only a handful of virions initiate infection of the midgut. The application of signal amplification strategies now enables critical assessment of the cellular and molecular interactions governing early infection events which could inform the development of novel interventions.

papers.abstract_zh: 节肢动物传播的病毒(虫媒病毒),例如 登革病毒,对全世界人类健康构成重大且日益严重的威胁。虫媒病毒维持在节肢动物 媒介 和脊椎动物 宿主 之间的 传播 循环中,在 传播 期间经历强大的瓶颈,这可以极大地改变病毒种群的组成和适应度。在媒介中,严重的群体瓶颈发生在感染的初始部位——中肠,但驱动这一过程的具体因素仍不清楚。为了研究这些机制,我们需要更好地了解早期感染事件;然而,传统的检测方法缺乏必要的灵敏度。基于分子信号放大的方法的最新进展现在使得详细研究这些早期阶段成为可能。在这项研究中,我们检查了伊蚊的早期 登革病毒 2 (DENV-2) 感染。使用多重杂交链式反应技术的埃及伊蚊中肠。我们证明这些技术比传统的免疫荧光测定灵敏得多,并且最早可以在感染后 6 小时可靠地检测蚊子中肠中的 DENV-2。此外,我们观察到了明显的瓶颈,因为只有少数病毒粒子引发中肠感染。信号放大策略的应用现在可以对控制早期感染事件的细胞和分子相互作用进行严格评估,这可以为新型干预措施的开发提供信息。

papers.title: Dengue virus 2 lacking N153 glycosylation displayed enhanced recognition by neutralizing antibodies
papers.abstract: Abstract Deglycosylated (N153Q) dengue virus (DENV) mutant shows attenuated infection in a mouse model, mainly due to its increased antibody susceptibility. This is consistent with the neutralization assay showing human monoclonal antibodies 2D22 and C10 are more potent towards the mutant than the wild-type (WT) virus. Here, we compared the cryoEM structures of WT and mutant viruses complexed with these Fabs (2.7-3.2 Å resolution). We observed increased occupancies for both Fabs on the mutant virus, suggesting higher accessibility of epitopes that were previously blocked by glycosylation. Using biolayer interferometry, we showed although the Fabs have slower binding rate to the mutant than WT virus, they also have slower dissociation rate. The slow dissociation rate might contribute to higher Fab occupancies, as once bound, they remain associated with the virus. N153Q mutant might be a good vaccine candidate, as important epitopes are made more accessible for stimulating highly potent antibodies.

Here, we compared the cryoEM structures of WT and mutant viruses complexed with these Fabs (2.7-3.2 Å resolution). We observed increased occupancies for both Fabs on the mutant virus, suggesting higher accessibility of epitopes that were previously blocked by glycosylation. Using biolayer interferometry, we showed although the Fabs have slower binding rate to the mutant than WT virus, they also have slower dissociation rate. The slow dissociation rate might contribute to higher Fab occupancies, as once bound, they remain associated with the virus. N153Q mutant might be a good vaccine candidate, as important epitopes are made more accessible for stimulating highly potent antibodies.

papers.title: Antibody Responses in Pediatric Dengue Indicate Emergence and Co-Circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar and Orthoflavivirus Cross-Reactivity.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health concern in Southeast Asia, disproportionately affecting children. In Myanmar, DENV-3 Genotype III predominated before 2017, with Genotype I emerging thereafter. To assess the impact of this emergence on antibody responses, we analyzed paired acute and convalescent serum samples from 38 pediatric dengue patients collected between 2017 and 2019 alongside archived 2004 samples. Neutralization and in vitro antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) were assessed against DENV-3 Genotypes I and III and other serotypes, with cross-reactivity analysis to Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses. Samples from 2004 showed reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time. In contrast, 2017-2019 samples exhibited comparable neutralization for both genotypes, with genotype- and year-dependent ADE differences, indicating that Genotype I emergence was associated with evolving functional antibody profiles. Hence, providing immunological evidence for continued co-circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar. Future prospective pediatric cohort studies with continuous surveillance of circulating orthoflaviviruses and their genotypes, are essential to elucidate how pre-existing dengue immunity shapes genotype emergence and cross-orthoflavivirus immunity in endemic regions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how the emergence of DENV-3 Genotype I alongside continued circulation of Genotype III in Myanmar influenced pediatric antibody responses. Using paired acute and convalescent sera from 38 children collected between 2017–2019 and archived 2004 samples, the authors measured neutralization and antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) against both genotypes and other dengue serotypes, including cross-reactivity to Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses. Samples from 2004 showed reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time, while 2017–2019 samples demonstrated comparable neutralization for both genotypes with genotype- and year-dependent ADE differences. The findings provide immunological evidence for the co-circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III and suggest that the emergence of Genotype I has been associated with evolving functional antibody profiles in pediatric patients. The study underscores the importance of continuous surveillance of circulating orthoflaviviruses and their genotypes to elucidate how pre-existing dengue immunity shapes genotype emergence and cross-orthoflavivirus immunity in endemic regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 仍然是东南亚的一个主要公共卫生问题,对儿童的影响尤其严重,但 DENV-3 基因型 I 的出现以及基因型 III 在缅甸的持续传播所产生的免疫影响尚不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 为了评估 DENV-3 基因型出现的免疫学影响,对 2017 年至 2019 年间收集的 38 名儿科登革热患者的配对急性和恢复期血清样本与 2004 年存档样本进行了分析。
elements_zh.methods: 针对 DENV-3 基因型 I 和 III 以及其他登革热血清型测量了中和作用和体外 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),并对寨卡病毒和日本脑炎病毒进行了额外的交叉反应分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 2004 年的样本显示,基因型 I 的中和作用降低,而 ADE 较高,而 2017-2019 年的样本,两种基因型的中和作用相当,具有基因型和年份依赖性的 ADE 差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为缅甸 DENV-3 基因型 I 和 III 的持续共循环提供了免疫学证据,表明基因型 I 的出现与儿科患者功能性抗体谱的演变有关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调需要对流行的正黄病毒及其基因型进行持续的 监测,以了解预先存在的登革热免疫如何影响流行地区的基因型出现和交叉正黄病毒免疫。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和对存档样本的依赖的限制,这些样本可能无法完全捕捉人群水平的免疫动态,因此需要谨慎地将证据强度解释为中等。

papers.title_zh: 儿科登革热的抗体反应表明缅甸 DENV-3 基因型 I 和 III 的出现和共同循环以及正黄病毒交叉反应。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health concern in Southeast Asia, disproportionately affecting children. In Myanmar, DENV-3 Genotype III predominated before 2017, with Genotype I emerging thereafter. To assess the impact of this emergence on antibody responses, we analyzed paired acute and convalescent serum samples from 38 pediatric dengue patients collected between 2017 and 2019 alongside archived 2004 samples. Neutralization and in vitro antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) were assessed against DENV-3 Genotypes I and III and other serotypes, with cross-reactivity analysis to Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses. Samples from 2004 showed reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time. In contrast, 2017-2019 samples exhibited comparable neutralization for both genotypes, with genotype- and year-dependent ADE differences, indicating that Genotype I emergence was associated with evolving functional antibody profiles. Hence, providing immunological evidence for continued co-circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar. Future prospective pediatric cohort studies with continuous surveillance of circulating orthoflaviviruses and their genotypes, are essential to elucidate how pre-existing dengue immunity shapes genotype emergence and cross-orthoflavivirus immunity in endemic regions.

papers.title: Neutralizing Dengue Antibodies after 10 years of the Chimeric Yellow Fever Tetravalent Dengue Vaccine (CYD-TDV) and Dengue Antibody Cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2 in Indonesia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue endemic countries were affected by the spread of COVID-19. In 2011, Indonesia participated in a multi-center phase III clinical trial of chimeric yellow fever tetravalent dengue vaccine (CYD-TDV). This study evaluates neutralizing dengue antibodies of CYD-TDV after 10 years during COVID-19 pandemic. OBJECTIVE: To assess neutralizing antibody against all four-dengue virus (DENV) serotypes and dengue incidence in individuals who received CYD-TDV after 10 years immunization in Indonesia. Additionally, to compare SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody titers and COVID-19 incidence between dengue-vaccinated and non-vaccinated groups. METHODS: This study was conducted across five healthcare centers in Jakarta (June-December 2022) involving 419 participants (207 dengue-vaccinated, 212 non-vaccinated). A cross-sectional study in subset of 79 dengue-vaccinated and 80 non-vaccinated participants were measured neutralizing antibodies against DENV and SARS-CoV-2, respectively. Simultaneously, all participants were given questionnaires to assess dengue and COVID-19 history. RESULTS: In adolescents (12-17 years), CYD-TDV recipients had significantly higher neutralizing antibody titers against DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-4, but not DENV-3. While, no significant differences were observed in adults (≥18 years) in both groups. Dengue incidence was similar between dengue-vaccinated (4.8%) and non-vaccinated (5.1%) groups. The SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody levels were not significantly different between groups. However, Incidence of hospitalized COVID-19 were higher in the dengue-vaccinated group. CONCLUSION: After a decade, CYD-TDV induced higher neutralizing antibody levels significantly for DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-4, but not for DENV-3 in adolescents but not in adults. The SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody levels were comparable between groups, However, COVID-19 hospitalizations were more frequent in dengue-vaccinated group.

papers.title_zh: 在印度尼西亚,嵌合黄热病四价登革热 疫苗 (CYD-TDV) 和登革热抗体与 SARS-CoV-2 交叉反应 10 年后中和登革热抗体。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue endemic countries were affected by the spread of COVID-19. In 2011, Indonesia participated in a multi-center phase III clinical trial of chimeric yellow fever tetravalent dengue vaccine (CYD-TDV). This study evaluates neutralizing dengue antibodies of CYD-TDV after 10 years during COVID-19 pandemic. OBJECTIVE: To assess neutralizing antibody against all four-dengue virus (DENV) serotypes and dengue incidence in individuals who received CYD-TDV after 10 years immunization in Indonesia. Additionally, to compare SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody titers and COVID-19 incidence between dengue-vaccinated and non-vaccinated groups. METHODS: This study was conducted across five healthcare centers in Jakarta (June-December 2022) involving 419 participants (207 dengue-vaccinated, 212 non-vaccinated). A cross-sectional study in subset of 79 dengue-vaccinated and 80 non-vaccinated participants were measured neutralizing antibodies against DENV and SARS-CoV-2, respectively. Simultaneously, all participants were given questionnaires to assess dengue and COVID-19 history. RESULTS: In adolescents (12-17 years), CYD-TDV recipients had significantly higher neutralizing antibody titers against DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-4, but not DENV-3. While, no significant differences were observed in adults (≥18 years) in both groups. Dengue incidence was similar between dengue-vaccinated (4.8%) and non-vaccinated (5.1%) groups. The SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody levels were not significantly different between groups. However, Incidence of hospitalized COVID-19 were higher in the dengue-vaccinated group. CONCLUSION: After a decade, CYD-TDV induced higher neutralizing antibody levels significantly for DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-4, but not for DENV-3 in adolescents but not in adults. The SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody levels were comparable between groups, However, COVID-19 hospitalizations were more frequent in dengue-vaccinated group.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革热流行国家受到了 COVID-19 传播的影响。2011年,印度尼西亚参与了嵌合黄热病四价登革热疫苗(CYD-TDV)的多中心III期临床试验。本研究评估了 COVID-19 大流行期间 10 年后 CYD-TDV 的中和登革热抗体。目的:评估印度尼西亚免疫 10 年后接受 CYD-TDV 的个体针对所有四种 登革病毒 (DENV) 血清型和登革热 发病率 的中和抗体。此外,还比较了登革热疫苗接种组和未接种疫苗组之间的 SARS-CoV-2 中和抗体滴度和 COVID-19 发病率。方法:这项研究在雅加达的五个医疗中心进行(2022 年 6 月至 12 月),涉及 419 名参与者(207 名接种了登革热疫苗,212 名未接种疫苗)。一项横断面研究对 79 名接种登革热疫苗和 80 名未接种疫苗的参与者分别测量了针对 DENV 和 SARS-CoV-2 的中和抗体。同时,所有参与者都收到了调查问卷,以评估登革热和 COVID-19 病史。结果:在青少年(12-17 岁)中,CYD-TDV 接受者针对 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 DENV-4 的中和抗体滴度显着较高,但针对 DENV-3 的中和抗体滴度则没有。然而,两组成年人(≥18 岁)没有观察到显着差异。登革热疫苗接种组 (4.8%) 和未接种疫苗组 (5.1%) 之间的登革热 发病率 相似。SARS-CoV-2 中和抗体水平在各组之间没有显着差异。然而,在登革热疫苗接种组中,住院的 COVID-19 的 发病率 较高。结论:十年后,CYD-TDV 在青少年中显着诱导较高的 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 DENV-4 中和抗体水平,但对 DENV-3 没有显着影响,但在成人中则不然。各组之间的 SARS-CoV-2 中和抗体水平相当,但接种登革热疫苗组的 COVID-19 住院率更高。

papers.title: Serological and Immunological Markers in Dengue Fever: A Retrospective ELISA-Based Pilot Study from Trinidad and Tobago
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever remains a major mosquito-borne viral disease in tropical and subtropical regions and continues to represent an important public health challenge in the Caribbean. Despite endemic transmission in Trinidad and Tobago, limited laboratory-based studies have evaluated serological markers associated with recent dengue infection. Objective: To evaluate serological and immunological markers associated with recent dengue virus infection through the detection of anti-dengue virus immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibodies in serum samples obtained from Trinidad and Tobago using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Methods: Anti-dengue virus IgM antibodies were detected using a commercial enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results were classified as positive, borderline or negative according to manufacturer-recommended criteria. Descriptive statistical analysis was performed to determine seroprevalence in anonymized serum samples. Results: A total of 161 serum samples were analyzed. Twenty samples (12.4%) demonstrated positive anti-dengue IgM reactivity, while 29 samples (18.0%) showed borderline reactivity and 112 samples (69.6%) were negative. Under the conservative analytical approach, the estimated dengue IgM seroprevalence was 12.4% (20/161; 95% CI: 7.7–18.6%). Conclusions: The estimated seroprevalence of dengue IgM in this pilot study was highly dependent on the analytical treatment of borderline ELISA results. Conservative classification provided the most cautious and reproducible estimate of recent dengue infection, while liberal interpretation substantially increased the apparent disease burden. Early viral replication triggers inflammation that progresses to cytokine-driven vascular damage, while cross-reactive humoral responses and host factors ultimately shape dengue severity. Ultimately, understanding the drivers of IgM cross-reactivity is essential for accurate dengue surveillance, outbreak detection, and clinical decision-making.

Despite endemic transmission in Trinidad and Tobago, limited laboratory-based studies have evaluated serological markers associated with recent dengue infection. Objective: To evaluate serological and immunological markers associated with recent dengue virus infection through the detection of anti-dengue virus immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibodies in serum samples obtained from Trinidad and Tobago using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Methods: Anti-dengue virus IgM antibodies were detected using a commercial enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results were classified as positive, borderline or negative according to manufacturer-recommended criteria. Descriptive statistical analysis was performed to determine seroprevalence in anonymized serum samples. Results: A total of 161 serum samples were analyzed. Twenty samples (12.4%) demonstrated positive anti-dengue IgM reactivity, while 29 samples (18.0%) showed borderline reactivity and 112 samples (69.6%) were negative. Under the conservative analytical approach, the estimated dengue IgM seroprevalence was 12.4% (20/161; 95% CI: 7.7–18.6%). Conclusions: The estimated seroprevalence of dengue IgM in this pilot study was highly dependent on the analytical treatment of borderline ELISA results. Conservative classification provided the most cautious and reproducible estimate of recent dengue infection, while liberal interpretation substantially increased the apparent disease burden. Early viral replication triggers inflammation that progresses to cytokine-driven vascular damage, while cross-reactive humoral responses and host factors ultimately shape dengue severity. Ultimately, understanding the drivers of IgM cross-reactivity is essential for accurate dengue surveillance, outbreak detection, and clinical decision-making.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever is a major public health challenge in the Caribbean, yet Trinidad and Tobago lack laboratory-based studies evaluating serological markers of recent infection. The study aimed to address this gap by assessing serological and immunological markers linked to recent dengue virus infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective pilot study analyzed anonymized serum samples from Trinidad and Tobago using ELISA to detect anti-dengue virus IgM antibodies. A total of 161 serum samples were included in the analysis.
analysis.methods: Anti-dengue virus IgM antibodies were detected using a commercial ELISA, with results classified as positive, borderline, or negative per manufacturer criteria. Descriptive statistical analysis was performed to determine seroprevalence.
analysis.main_results: Twenty samples (12.4%) were positive for anti-dengue IgM, 29 (18.0%) were borderline, and 112 (69.6%) were negative. Under conservative classification, the estimated dengue IgM seroprevalence was 12.4% (20/161; 95% CI: 7.7–18.6%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The estimated seroprevalence was highly dependent on the analytical treatment of borderline ELISA results, with conservative classification providing the most cautious estimate of recent dengue infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Understanding IgM cross-reactivity drivers is essential for accurate dengue surveillance, outbreak detection, and clinical decision-making in endemic settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size and reliance on ELISA without confirmatory testing limit generalizability and precision, warranting a low confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective pilot study from Trinidad and Tobago evaluated serological markers of recent dengue virus infection using ELISA to detect anti-dengue IgM antibodies in 161 anonymized serum samples. The study found an estimated dengue IgM seroprevalence of 12.4% under conservative classification, with 12.4% positive, 18.0% borderline, and 69.6% negative results. The authors highlight that seroprevalence estimates were highly sensitive to the analytical handling of borderline ELISA results, with conservative classification yielding the most cautious estimate. They emphasize the need to understand IgM cross-reactivity for accurate surveillance and clinical decision-making in dengue-endemic regions. However, the small sample size and lack of confirmatory testing limit the study’s generalizability and precision.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是加勒比地区的一项重大公共卫生挑战,但特立尼达和多巴哥缺乏评估近期感染血清学标志物的实验室研究。该研究旨在通过评估与近期 登革病毒 感染相关的血清学和免疫学标记物来解决这一差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性试点研究使用 ELISA 分析了来自特立尼达和多巴哥的匿名血清样本,以检测抗 登革病毒 IgM 抗体。分析中总共包括 161 份血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用商业 ELISA 检测抗 登革病毒 IgM 抗体,根据制造商标准将结果分类为阳性、临界或阴性。进行描述性统计分析以确定血清流行率。
elements_zh.main_results: 20 个样本 (12.4%) 抗登革热 IgM 呈阳性,29 个样本 (18.0%) 呈临界值,112 个样本 (69.6%) 呈阴性。在保守分类下,估计的登革热 IgM 血清流行率 为 12.4%(20/161;95% CI:7.7-18.6%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 估计的 血清流行率 高度依赖于边界 ELISA 结果的分析 治疗,保守分类提供了对近期登革热感染的最谨慎的估计。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 了解 IgM 交叉反应驱动因素对于登革热 监测、暴发 的准确检测和流行环境中的临床决策至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,并且依赖 ELISA,没有进行验证性测试,限制了普遍性和精确度,因此评估的置信度较低。

Ultimately, understanding the drivers of IgM cross-reactivity is essential for accurate dengue surveillance, outbreak detection, and clinical decision-making.

papers.title: Wolbachia-mediated dengue control remains robust under insecticide stress in Aedes aegypti
papers.abstract: Abstract Wolbachia -based interventions have become a successful biological strategy to reduce dengue virus (DENV) transmission by Aedes aegypti . However, whether the protective phenotypes conferred by this symbiont remain stable under environmental stress remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated the impact of sublethal insecticide (deltamethrin) exposure on multiple components of the Wolbachia – Aedes aegypti –DENV system, including pathogen blocking, cytoplasmic incompatibility, host reproductive traits, symbiont density, and viral diversity. We show that insecticide exposure induces a transient reduction in Wolbachia density, which rapidly recovers without compromising DENV blocking, cytoplasmic incompatibility, or reproductive performance. In addition, insecticide exposure has a negligible impact on viral genetic diversity in mosquito saliva. These findings demonstrate the robustness of Wolbachia -mediated pathogen blocking under chemical stress and provide evidence that symbiont-based biological control can remain effective under environmentally challenging conditions.

analysis.study_design_and_population: This study investigated the impact of sublethal deltamethrin exposure on the Wolbachia–Aedes aegypti–DENV system, including pathogen blocking, cytoplasmic incompatibility, host reproductive traits, symbiont density, and viral diversity. The research was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting using Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia and DENV.
analysis.methods: The researchers exposed Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to sublethal concentrations of deltamethrin and assessed various components of the Wolbachia–DENV system, including symbiont density, pathogen blocking efficiency, cytoplasmic incompatibility, reproductive performance, and viral genetic diversity in mosquito saliva.
analysis.main_results: Insecticide exposure caused a transient reduction in Wolbachia density, which recovered rapidly. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that Wolbachia-mediated dengue control remains robust under chemical stress, highlighting the potential of symbiont-based biological control strategies to function effectively in environmentally challenging conditions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide important insights for public health strategies, suggesting that Wolbachia-based interventions can maintain their efficacy even when mosquitoes are exposed to insecticides, which is critical for sustainable dengue control programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in a controlled laboratory environment, which may limit its generalizability to real-world conditions. However, the evidence is strong and directly supports the robustness of Wolbachia-mediated dengue control under insecticide stress.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决有关环境压力下沃尔巴克氏体介导的登革热控制稳定性的知识差距,因为这种生物策略在现实条件下的有效性仍然知之甚少。研究问题集中在当暴露于亚致死杀虫剂水平时,沃尔巴克氏体所赋予的保护表型是否持续存在。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了亚致死溴氰菊酯暴露对沃尔巴克氏体-埃及伊蚊-DENV系统的影响,包括病原体阻断、细胞质不相容性、宿主繁殖性状、共生体密度和病毒多样性。该研究是在受控实验室环境中使用感染沃尔巴克氏体和登革热病毒的埃及伊蚊进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员将埃及伊蚊暴露于亚致死浓度的溴氰菊酯中,并评估了沃尔巴克氏体-DENV系统的各个组成部分,包括共生体密度、病原体阻断效率、细胞质不相容性、繁殖性能和蚊子唾液中的病毒遗传多样性。
elements_zh.main_results: 接触杀虫剂导致沃尔巴克氏体密度短暂降低,但随后又迅速恢复。DENV 阻断、细胞质不相容性和繁殖性能并未受到杀虫剂胁迫的影响。此外,蚊子唾液中的病毒遗传多样性并未受到影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,沃尔巴克氏体介导的登革热控制在化学胁迫下仍然有效,凸显了基于共生体的生物控制策略在环境挑战条件下有效发挥作用的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为公共卫生策略提供了重要见解,表明即使蚊子接触杀虫剂,基于沃尔巴克氏体的干预措施也能保持其功效,这对于可持续登革热控制计划至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在受控实验室环境中进行的,这可能会限制其对现实条件的推广。然而,证据确凿,直接支持沃尔巴克氏体介导的登革热控制在杀虫剂胁迫下的稳健性。

We show that insecticide exposure induces a transient reduction in Wolbachia density, which rapidly recovers without compromising DENV blocking, cytoplasmic incompatibility, or reproductive performance. In addition, insecticide exposure has a negligible impact on viral genetic diversity in mosquito saliva. These findings demonstrate the robustness of Wolbachia -mediated pathogen blocking under chemical stress and provide evidence that symbiont-based biological control can remain effective under environmentally challenging conditions.

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Carica papaya L.: A Comprehensive Review on Its Antiviral Activity and Therapeutic Role in Dengue Management
papers.abstract: Dengue is a rapidly expanding global health problem for which no specific antiviral therapy is currently available, leaving disease management largely supportive and symptomatic. Severe thrombocytopenia is a major clinical concern in dengue infection, while prophylactic platelet transfusion can be costly and may not always be readily accessible. Carica papaya leaf juice (CPLJ) has been used off-label in the management of dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever and has been reported to increase platelet counts in thrombocytopenic children and adults with minimal adverse effects. This review synthesizes evidence on the antiviral activity and therapeutic potential of CPLJ and C. papaya leaf extracts in the treatment and recovery of dengue-infected patients. It examines recent findings from in vitro and in vivo studies, documented clinical trials, traditional applications, and research on the phytochemicals, amino acids, and other bioactive constituents of C. The reviewed evidence indicates that CPLJ and its extracts may inhibit dengue virus activity, increase platelet counts, and support recovery among patients with dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever. These findings suggest that C. papaya leaves represent a promising natural source of bioactive compounds for developing supportive or antiviral interventions against dengue virus infection. Nevertheless, further rigorous pharmacological and clinical investigations are required to establish standardized formulations, therapeutic dosages, mechanisms of action, safety profiles, and clinical efficacy.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注番木瓜在登革热治疗中的 抗病毒药物 活性和治疗作用,特别研究其解决 抗病毒药物 感染和血小板减少等相​​关并发症的潜力。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述综合了番木瓜的体外和体内研究、记录的临床试验、传统应用以及植物化学物质、氨基酸和生物活性成分的研究的证据。

papers.title_zh: 释放番木瓜的潜力:对其 抗病毒药物 活性和登革热治疗作用的综合评价
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is a rapidly expanding global health problem for which no specific antiviral therapy is currently available, leaving disease management largely supportive and symptomatic. Severe thrombocytopenia is a major clinical concern in dengue infection, while prophylactic platelet transfusion can be costly and may not always be readily accessible. Carica papaya leaf juice (CPLJ) has been used off-label in the management of dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever and has been reported to increase platelet counts in thrombocytopenic children and adults with minimal adverse effects. This review synthesizes evidence on the antiviral activity and therapeutic potential of CPLJ and C. papaya leaf extracts in the treatment and recovery of dengue-infected patients. It examines recent findings from in vitro and in vivo studies, documented clinical trials, traditional applications, and research on the phytochemicals, amino acids, and other bioactive constituents of C. The reviewed evidence indicates that CPLJ and its extracts may inhibit dengue virus activity, increase platelet counts, and support recovery among patients with dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever. These findings suggest that C. papaya leaves represent a promising natural source of bioactive compounds for developing supportive or antiviral interventions against dengue virus infection. Nevertheless, further rigorous pharmacological and clinical investigations are required to establish standardized formulations, therapeutic dosages, mechanisms of action, safety profiles, and clinical efficacy.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是一种迅速蔓延的全球健康问题,目前尚无特定的 抗病毒药物 疗法,因此疾病管理主要是支持性和对症治疗。严重的血小板减少症是登革热感染的一个主要临床问题,而预防性血小板输注可能成本高昂,而且并不总是容易获得。番木瓜叶汁 (CPLJ) 已被超说明书用于治疗 登革热 和登革出血热,据报道可增加血小板减少症儿童和成人的血小板计数,且副作用最小。本综述综合了有关 抗病毒药物 活性以及 CPLJ 和木瓜叶提取物在 抗病毒药物 中的治疗潜力以及登革热感染患者康复的证据。它审查了来自体外和体内研究、记录的临床试验、传统应用以及对 C 的植物化学物质、氨基酸和其他生物活性成分的研究的最新发现。审查的证据表明 CPLJ 及其提取物可能抑制 登革病毒 活性,增加血小板计数,并支持 登革热 和登革出血热患者的康复。这些发现表明,番木瓜叶代表了一种有前途的生物活性化合物天然来源,可用于开发针对 抗病毒药物 感染的支持性或 抗病毒药物 干预措施。然而,需要进一步严格的药理学和临床研究来建立标准化的配方、治疗剂量、作用机制、安全性和临床疗效。

papers.title: An enzyme-free HCR-amplified colorimetric biosensor based on a Cu2+/rGO nanozyme for detection of dengue virus.
papers.abstract: Rapid and cost-effective detection of dengue infection, especially during the early stages of disease and in resource-limited settings, remains a significant public health concern. Recent advances in nanomaterial-based biosensors have provided promising opportunities for the development of simple, sensitive, and affordable nucleic acid detection platforms. In the present study, a Cu2+-modified reduced graphene oxide (Cu2+/rGO) nanostructure-based colorimetric biosensor integrated with hybridization chain reaction (HCR) was developed and assessed for the detection of a dengue virus target sequence. The nanozyme exhibited peroxidase-like activity and catalyzed the oxidation of 3,3',5,5'-tetramethylbenzidine (TMB) in the presence of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), generating a visible colorimetric signal. Following HCR-mediated double-stranded DNA formation, the catalytic activity of the nanostructure was suppressed, resulting in reduced color intensity and enabling signal-off detection. The proposed biosensor showed a linear response over 0.5-10 nM, with detection limits of 1.36 nM in buffer and 1.6 nM in human serum samples spiked with synthetic target DNA. The color variation was directly visible to the naked eye. The assay showed good linearity (R2 = 0.9868) while avoiding the need for thermocyclers and complex instrumentation. The Cu2+/rGO nanozyme preserved nearly 79% of its catalytic performance after 10 days of storage. Overall, the results suggest that the developed platform may provide a practical and cost-effective biosensing strategy for preliminary nucleic acid screening in resource-limited settings and complement conventional polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based assays.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 快速且经济高效地检测登革热感染,特别是在疾病早期阶段和资源有限的环境中,仍然是一个重大的公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本研究中,开发并评估了一种与杂交链式反应(HCR)集成的基于Cu2+修饰的还原氧化石墨烯(Cu2+/rGO)纳米结构的比色生物传感器,用于检测登革病毒目标序列。
elements_zh.methods: 该纳米酶表现出类似过氧化物酶的活性,并在过氧化氢(H2O2)存在下催化3,3',5,5'-四甲基联苯胺(TMB)的氧化,产生可见的比色信号。HCR 介导的双链 DNA 形成后,纳米结构的催化活性受到抑制,导致颜色强度降低并实现信号关闭检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 所提出的生物传感器表现出超过 0.5-10 nM 的线性响应,缓冲液中的检测限为 1.36 nM,掺有合成目标 DNA 的人血清样品中的检测限为 1.6 nM。肉眼直接可见颜色变化。该测定显示出良好的线性(R2 = 0.9868),同时避免了热循环仪和复杂仪器的需要。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Cu2+/rGO纳米酶在储存10天后保留了近79%的催化性能。总体而言,结果表明,所开发的平台可以为资源有限环境中的初步核酸筛查提供实用且具有成本效益的生物传感策略,并补充传统的基于聚合酶链式反应(PCR)的测定。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 开发的生物传感器为 登革病毒 检测提供了一个简单、灵敏且经济实惠的核酸检测平台,特别适用于可能无法进行传统 PCR 检测的资源有限的环境。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是使用掺入人血清样本中的合成目标 DNA 进行的,这可能无法完全反映真实世界的临床样本。由于使用了合成靶标并且需要用临床标本进一步验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: AWARENESS, ATTITUDES, AND PREVENTIVE PRACTICES TOWARD DENGUE FEVER CONTROL AMONG THE GENERAL POPULATION IN JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever remains a growing public health concern in endemic and emerging settings, with effective control largely dependent on community awareness and preventive behaviors. This study aimed to assess knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices (KAP) regarding dengue fever among residents of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and to examine their association with sociodemographic characteristics. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted in Jeddah from October 2025 to March 2026 among adult Arabic-speaking residents aged â‰¥18 years. Data were collected using a structured, self-administered questionnaire based on the KAP framework, distributed both online and through community-based public health campaigns across different districts of the city. KAP scores were analyzed, and associations with sociodemographic variables were assessed using comparative statistics, correlation analysis, and logistic regression.
