papers.title: Geographic expansion, not viral intensification, leads to human dengue outbreaks in Mexico: a 40-year integrated remote sensing and machine learning analysis
papers.abstract: Background Dengue fever poses a pervasive, yet escalating public health burden in Mexico and abroad. Methods We conducted a 41-year spatiotemporal analysis of dengue fever across Mexico (1985–2025), integrating monthly case surveillance with climate, land cover, vegetation, and novel disaster severity covariates derived from the Emergency Events Database. Four supervised regression models were trained on 1990–2021 data, with models evaluated on a 2022–2023 temporal holdout and against observed 2024–2025 surveillance totals. Five supplementary hazard analyses examined temporal correlation, disaster type breakdown, spatial co-occurrence, pre/post event trajectories, and sensitivity to scoring weight assumptions. Results Mann–Kendall trend analysis identified statistically significant increasing dengue incidence in 15 of 32 states (9 inland), evidencing geographic expansion over four decades. Z-score analysis confirmed 2024 as a profound anomaly across both endemic and emerging states. Hazard features were significantly associated with national monthly dengue counts at lags 0–2 months across the full 1985–2025 series. A + 613% case increase following the June 2024 tropical storm. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the project’s developed ‘Severity Score’ performed comparably to four theoretically motivated differential weighting schemes. Conclusion This study provides the first structured integration of disaster severity covariates in a dengue forecasting framework for Mexico. Geographic expansion into inland states, the 41-year trend analysis, and the hazard adjustment results collectively support a differentiated public health response that targets both endemic coastal states and newly affected inland regions. The analytical framework is directly transferable to emerging dengue risk contexts in the United States and Central America, geographic neighbors also experiencing increased dengue virus transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the drivers of human dengue outbreaks in Mexico over a 41-year period, using a spatiotemporal analysis that integrates monthly case surveillance with climate, land cover, vegetation, and disaster severity covariates. The study highlights the 2024 anomaly as a profound deviation from previous patterns and introduces a novel forecasting framework incorporating disaster severity. These findings suggest a need for targeted public health responses in both coastal and newly affected inland regions. However, the study is based on abstract-only evidence, and its moderate confidence is due to the reliance on historical data and potential confounding factors.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对墨西哥 (1985-2025) 的 登革热 进行了 41 年的时空分析,将每月案例 监测 与气候、土地覆盖、植被和灾害严重程度协变量整合起来。该研究重点关注 32 个州,其中 15 个内陆州的 发病率 有所增加。
elements_zh.methods: 四个监督回归模型根据 1990-2021 年的数据进行训练,模型根据 2022-2023 年的时间保留和观察到的 2024-2025 年 监测 总数进行评估。五项补充灾害分析检查了时间相关性、灾害类型细分、空间共现、事件前/后轨迹以及对评分权重假设的敏感性。
elements_zh.main_results: Mann-Kendall 趋势分析发现,在 32 个州中的 15 个州(9 个内陆州)中,登革热 发病率 呈显着增长趋势,这证明了四十年来的地理扩张。Z 分数分析证实 2024 年对于流行国家和新兴国家来说都是一个深刻的异常。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究首次在墨西哥登革热预测框架中对灾害严重程度协变量进行了结构化整合,强调了地理扩张在推动 暴发 中的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持针对流行的沿海国家和新受影响的内陆地区采取差异化的公共卫生应对措施,为监测和登革热多发地区的干预策略提供见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象分析,由于依赖历史数据且可能存在未解释的混杂因素,因此证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 登革热 在墨西哥和国外造成了普遍且不断升级的公共卫生负担。方法 我们对墨西哥各地的 登革热(1985 年至 2025 年)进行了 41 年的时空分析,将每月案例 监测 与气候、土地覆盖、植被和来自紧急事件数据库的新型灾害严重程度协变量相结合。四个监督回归模型根据 1990-2021 年的数据进行训练,模型根据 2022-2023 年的时间保留和观察到的 2024-2025 年 监测 总数进行评估。五项补充灾害分析检查了时间相关性、灾害类型细分、空间共现、事件前/后轨迹以及对评分权重假设的敏感性。结果 Mann-Kendall 趋势分析发现,在 32 个州中的 15 个州(9 个内陆州)中,登革热 发病率 呈显着增加趋势,这证明了四十年来的地理扩张。Z 分数分析证实 2024 年对于流行国家和新兴国家来说都是一个深刻的异常。在整个 1985-2025 年系列中,危害特征与滞后 0-2 个月的全国每月登革热计数显着相关。2024 年 6 月热带风暴过后,病例增加了 613%。敏感性分析证实了该项目开发的“严重性评分”的表现与四种理论上驱动的差分加权方案相当。结论 本研究首次在墨西哥登革热预测框架中对灾害严重程度协变量进行了结构化整合。向内陆州的地理扩张、41年趋势分析和灾害调整结果共同支持针对流行性沿海州和新受影响的内陆地区采取差异化的公共卫生应对措施。该分析框架可直接应用于美国和中美洲新兴的登革热风险环境,地理邻国也经历着 登革病毒 传播 的增加。

analysis_zh.main_results: Mann-Kendall 趋势分析发现,在 32 个州中的 15 个州(9 个内陆州)中,登革热 发病率 呈显着增长趋势,这证明了四十年来的地理扩张。Z 分数分析证实 2024 年对于流行国家和新兴国家来说都是一个深刻的异常。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究首次在墨西哥登革热预测框架中对灾害严重程度协变量进行了结构化整合,强调了地理扩张在推动 暴发 中的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持针对流行的沿海国家和新受影响的内陆地区采取差异化的公共卫生应对措施,为监测和登革热多发地区的干预策略提供见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象分析,由于依赖历史数据且可能存在未解释的混杂因素,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Preparedness of Local Institutions for Dengue and Other Arboviral Threats: A Cross-Sectional Study of Italian Municipalities
papers.abstract: Dengue and other arboviruses are a rising public health concern, worsened by climate change, globalization, and weak vector control. This study assessed the preparedness of local institutions and general practitioners (GPs)/paediatricians in ASL Roma 5 (Lazio, Italy) for potential arboviral outbreaks. A cross-sectional survey (April–May 2024) conducted 99 interviews: 57 with mayors and 42 with general GPs/paediatricians. A Health Belief Model (HBM)-based questionnaire assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding arbovirus transmission and management. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests. Dengue transmission awareness was low. Most mayors (85.96%) and GPs/paediatricians (88.1%) rated community knowledge as poor; 12.8% of mayors and 4.76% of GPs/paediatricians believed residents recognized local transmission risks. Environmental prevention programs were reported by 57.89% of mayors and 26.19% of GPs/paediatricians. Staff resource adequacy perceptions differed significantly (73.33% GPs/paediatricians vs. 21.82% mayors; p = 0.0005). In emergencies, 84.62% of GPs/paediatricians and 66.07% of mayors felt ready to act within 24 h. Local administrations face organizational and staffing limitations that hinder effective dengue prevention. While GPs/paediatricians showed greater confidence, they stressed the need for further training. Enhancing risk communication, environmental management, and intersectoral collaboration is crucial to improve preparedness for dengue and emerging arboviruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue and other arboviruses pose a growing public health threat in Italy due to climate change, globalization, and insufficient vector control, prompting the need to assess local institutional preparedness for potential outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional survey was conducted from April to May 2024 in ASL Roma 5 (Lazio, Italy), involving 99 participants: 57 mayors and 42 general practitioners (GPs)/paediatricians.
analysis.methods: A Health Belief Model-based questionnaire was administered to evaluate knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding arbovirus transmission and management, with data analyzed using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests.
analysis.main_results: Dengue transmission awareness was low, with 85.96% of mayors and 88.1% of GPs/paediatricians rating community knowledge as poor; only 12.8% of mayors and 4.76% of GPs/paediatricians believed residents recognized local transmission risks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights significant gaps in local preparedness, with GPs/paediatricians reporting greater readiness to act in emergencies but emphasizing the need for further training, underscoring the urgency of improving risk communication and intersectoral collaboration.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that organizational and staffing limitations in local administrations hinder effective dengue prevention, necessitating targeted interventions to enhance surveillance, training, and community engagement.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit causal inference and generalizability, while the small sample size from a single region further constrains the evidence strength, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed the preparedness of local institutions and healthcare providers in ASL Roma 5 (Lazio, Italy) for dengue and other arboviral threats through a Health Belief Model-based survey conducted in April–May 2024. Among 99 participants (57 mayors and 42 GPs/paediatricians), awareness of dengue transmission was low, with most rating community knowledge as poor and few recognizing local transmission risks. Environmental prevention programs were reported by 57.89% of mayors and 26.19% of GPs/paediatricians, while staff resource adequacy perceptions differed significantly (73.33% GPs/paediatricians vs. 21.82% mayors; p = 0.0005). Despite greater confidence among GPs/paediatricians to act within 24 hours during emergencies (84.62% vs. 66.07%), both groups stressed the need for further training. The study concludes that organizational and staffing limitations impede effective dengue prevention, emphasizing the need for improved risk communication, environmental management, and intersectoral collaboration.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于气候变化、全球化和 媒介 控制不足,登革热和其他虫媒病毒对意大利的公共卫生威胁日益严重,因此需要评估当地机构对潜在 暴发 的准备情况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 4 月至 5 月在 ASL Roma 5(意大利拉齐奥)进行了一项横断面调查,涉及 99 名参与者:57 名市长和 42 名全科医生 (GP)/儿科医生。
elements_zh.methods: 进行了基于健康信念模型的问卷调查,以评估有关虫媒病毒 传播 和管理的知识、态度和实践,并使用描述性统计和卡方检验对数据进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热传播认知度较低,85.96%的市长和88.1%的全科医生/儿科医生认为社区知识较差;只有 12.8% 的市长和 4.76% 的全科医生/儿科医生认为居民认识到当地的 传播 风险。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究突显了当地准备工作的巨大差距,全科医生/儿科医生报告说,他们在紧急情况下采取行动的准备程度更高,但强调需要进一步培训,强调改善风险沟通和部门间合作的紧迫性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,地方行政部门的组织和人员配置限制阻碍了登革热的有效预防,因此需要采取有针对性的干预措施来加强 监测、培训和社区参与。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横截面设计和对自我报告数据的依赖限制了因果推断和普遍性,而来自单个区域的小样本量进一步限制了证据强度,需要谨慎解释。

papers.title_zh: 地方机构应对登革热和其他虫媒病毒威胁的准备情况:意大利城市的横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue and other arboviruses are a rising public health concern, worsened by climate change, globalization, and weak vector control. This study assessed the preparedness of local institutions and general practitioners (GPs)/paediatricians in ASL Roma 5 (Lazio, Italy) for potential arboviral outbreaks. A cross-sectional survey (April–May 2024) conducted 99 interviews: 57 with mayors and 42 with general GPs/paediatricians. A Health Belief Model (HBM)-based questionnaire assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding arbovirus transmission and management. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests. Dengue transmission awareness was low. Most mayors (85.96%) and GPs/paediatricians (88.1%) rated community knowledge as poor; 12.8% of mayors and 4.76% of GPs/paediatricians believed residents recognized local transmission risks. Environmental prevention programs were reported by 57.89% of mayors and 26.19% of GPs/paediatricians. Staff resource adequacy perceptions differed significantly (73.33% GPs/paediatricians vs. 21.82% mayors; p = 0.0005). In emergencies, 84.62% of GPs/paediatricians and 66.07% of mayors felt ready to act within 24 h. Local administrations face organizational and staffing limitations that hinder effective dengue prevention. While GPs/paediatricians showed greater confidence, they stressed the need for further training. Enhancing risk communication, environmental management, and intersectoral collaboration is crucial to improve preparedness for dengue and emerging arboviruses.

papers.title: Dengue fever outbreak in Iran: Urgent warnings and solutions
papers.abstract: Dear Editor, Following the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue fever, one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases, has become a serious public health challenge in many countries around the world in recent years. Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate. Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country’s health system. Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action. Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public. By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

papers.title: Evaluating knowledge and attitudes towards dengue fever and its vaccination in China: A questionnaire-based study in healthcare practitioners
papers.abstract: Dengue, a mosquito-borne tropical disease caused by the dengue virus, has seen a significant increase in global incidence in recent decades. China has experienced a rapid rise in dengue cases since 2013, posing a serious threat to population health and increasing economic burden. This study aimed to evaluate the knowledge of, and attitudes toward, dengue fever and dengue vaccination among healthcare practitioners in China. A cross-sectional study was conducted using an online questionnaire survey targeting medical professionals in Zhejiang, Yunnan, and Hainan provinces, which are endemic areas for dengue virus infection in China. The questionnaire assessed participants’ understanding of dengue virus transmission, high-risk groups, symptoms, and knowledge of and attitudes toward dengue vaccines. Results showed that 98.6% of participants reported having prior knowledge of dengue virus. Knowledge of at-risk populations was strongly associated with actual dengue knowledge and vaccine attitudes, which may drive vaccine acceptance. Most respondents (71.0%) held neutral attitudes toward dengue vaccination, followed by 20.8% who held positive attitudes and 8.2% who held negative attitudes. Individuals with neutral attitudes were the most critical in determining vaccine acceptance. papers.title: Externally validated delay-embedded dynamic mode decomposition and annual-frequency SPOD reveal robust state-level dengue timing organization in Brazil
papers.abstract: We evaluated delay-embedded dynamic mode decomposition (Hankel DMD) as a signal-diagnostic framework for annual dengue timing across Brazil. Weekly InfoDengue estimates were aggregated into 27 state-level incidence trajectories for 2015–2024. The primary model used state-standardized log1p incidence, a 26-week delay embedding, and rank 12. Annual structure was extracted with Hankel DMD, corroborated by annual-frequency spectral proper orthogonal decomposition (SPOD), and related to official OpenDataSUS epidemic onset in a state-year model adjusted for preseason climate, serotype information, and year. Robustness was assessed across 143 transformation-delay-rank specifications and by leave-one-year-out, rolling four-year, and annual-harmonic analyses. The primary Hankel mode had frequency 0.9865 cycles/year. SPOD selected 1.000 cycle/year, assigned 81.9% of leading-mode spectral energy to the annual bin, and reproduced the DMD phase pattern (circular correlation 0.996; median absolute difference 0.72 weeks). The adjusted phase coefficient was − 2.23 weeks per standard deviation (95% CI − 2.78 to − 1.80 ), indicating earlier official onset toward the leading end of the externally oriented phase. Of 143 sensitivity specifications, 135 yielded an unambiguous annual mode; their median phase correlation with the primary result was 0.969 and median absolute difference was 1.09 weeks. Leave-one-year-out correlations ranged from 0.984 to 0.999 and were not reduced when major epidemic years were omitted (permutation p = 0.7384 ). Hankel DMD identifies a reproducible state-level annual timing organization. Phase is a relative modal coordinate externally oriented by onset data, not a causal transmission parameter.

papers.source_body_en: We evaluated delay-embedded dynamic mode decomposition (Hankel DMD) as a signal-diagnostic framework for annual dengue timing across Brazil. Weekly InfoDengue estimates were aggregated into 27 state-level incidence trajectories for 2015–2024. The primary model used state-standardized log1p incidence, a 26-week delay embedding, and rank 12. Annual structure was extracted with Hankel DMD, corroborated by annual-frequency spectral proper orthogonal decomposition (SPOD), and related to official OpenDataSUS epidemic onset in a state-year model adjusted for preseason climate, serotype information, and year. Robustness was assessed across 143 transformation-delay-rank specifications and by leave-one-year-out, rolling four-year, and annual-harmonic analyses. The primary Hankel mode had frequency 0.9865 cycles/year. SPOD selected 1.000 cycle/year, assigned 81.9% of leading-mode spectral energy to the annual bin, and reproduced the DMD phase pattern (circular correlation 0.996; median absolute difference 0.72 weeks). papers.title: Coinfections of Chikungunya, Dengue, and Zika Viruses in India: Rationale for a Unified Triple Surveillance Approach
papers.abstract: Aedes -borne arboviruses are a major public health threat in India and globally. Arboviruses spread by the Aedes mosquito, namely, the Zika, chikungunya, and dengue viruses, pose overlapping and significant threats. In the Indian context, dengue is widespread and hyperendemic across many regions of the country, chikungunya has re-emerged markedly since the mid-2000s, and Zika outbreaks have appeared sporadically across several states. Because these viruses share the same mosquito vectors, the chances of coinfection and cocirculation increase, making diagnosis difficult. papers.abstract_zh: 伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒是印度和全球的主要公共卫生威胁。由伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,即寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅病毒和 登革病毒,构成了重叠的重大威胁。在印度,登革热在该国许多地区广泛流行,基孔肯雅热自 2000 年代中期以来明显重新出现,寨卡病毒 暴发 在多个邦零星出现。由于这些病毒共享同一个蚊子媒介,因此同时感染和共循环的机会增加,使得诊断变得困难。此外,在这种合并感染的情况下,临床表现可能会变得更加复杂。尽管存在这样的现实,大多数 监测 的努力还是分别针对每种疾病。在本研究中,我们回顾了印度登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒混合感染的证据,确定了诊断和 监测 方面的差距,并提出了一种综合的“三重 监测”方法来更好地跟踪和管理这些病毒性疾病。

papers.title: Clinical profile of dengue patients presenting with epistaxis at a tertiary hospital in Kathmandu, Nepal
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever poses a major global public health challenge, with a rising burden in countries like Nepal, where it can progress to severe dengue. Severe dengue, as defined by WHO criteria, manifests with critical plasma leakage leading to shock, severe hemorrhagic complications, and organ impairment. Epistaxis, though not a classic presenting symptom, may reflect underlying coagulopathy and signal heightened disease severity. However, the demographic profile, clinical characteristics, and outcomes of dengue patients presenting with epistaxis remain undescribed in Nepal. This study describes the clinical and laboratory profile of such patients admitted to a tertiary care hospital. Methods We performed a retrospective observational study based on hospital records of patients admitted to Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital, Kathmandu, Nepal, between 1st September 2022 and 30th November 2024. Patients with NS1-positive dengue fever who developed epistaxis during the course of illness were included. Data on demographics, comorbidities, prior medication use, timing of epistaxis, hospital stay, additional bleeding manifestations, hematological parameters (platelet count, WBC count, PT/INR), liver enzymes (AST/ALT), and transfusion requirements were analyzed. Result A total of 27 patients with dengue fever and epistaxis were evaluated. The mean age was 42 years, and the majority (70.37%) were male. Epistaxis was the initial presentation among 59.26% of patients, while 40.74% developed it during hospitalization. Epistaxis typically occurred around day 4–7 of illness. At the time of epistaxis, the mean WBC count was 5462.96/μL (range 1,600 − 14,700/μL), and the mean platelet count was around 30,000/μL. Decreasing trend of WBC counts and an increasing trend of platelet counts were seen in the majority of patients. AST and ALT were elevated (mean AST 424 U/L, ALT: 166 U/L). One-third of patients experienced additional bleeding, most commonly from oral mucosa, followed by GI bleeding. Overall, 62.96% required transfusion, and the mean platelet transfusion was about 4 pints. Among those with bleeding from other sites, 89% required transfusion, highlighting the increased severity in this subgroup. Conclusion Epistaxis in dengue patients most commonly occurs during the critical phase of illness and is associated with severe thrombocytopenia, hepatic dysfunction, and an increased risk of multisite bleeding. Although not all patients require transfusion, epistaxis may serve as an early clinical marker of severe dengue, underscoring the need for vigilant monitoring and timely intervention to prevent complications. Clinical trail Not applicable.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热 构成了一项重大的全球公共卫生挑战,尼泊尔等国家的负担不断增加,而在这些国家,重症登革热 可能会发展到 重症登革热。根据 WHO 标准定义,重症登革热 表现为严重血浆渗漏,导致休克、严重出血并发症和器官损伤。鼻衄虽然不是典型的症状,但可能反映潜在的凝血病并表明疾病严重程度增加。然而,尼泊尔出现鼻衄的登革热患者的人口统计学特征、临床特征和结果仍未得到描述。本研究描述了三级甲等医院收治的此类患者的临床和实验室概况。方法 我们根据 2022 年 9 月 1 日至 2024 年 11 月 30 日期间入住尼泊尔加德满都特里布万大学教学医院的患者的医院记录进行了一项回顾性观察研究。其中包括病程中出现鼻出血的 NS1 阳性 登革热 患者。分析了人口统计学、合并症、既往用药情况、鼻出血时间、住院时间、额外出血表现、血液学参数(血小板计数、白细胞计数、PT/INR)、肝酶(AST/ALT)和输血需求的数据。结果 共评价27例登革热合并鼻衄患者。平均年龄为42岁,大多数(70.37%)为男性。59.26% 的患者以鼻衄为首发症状,40.74% 的患者在住院期间出现鼻出血。鼻出血通常发生在患病第 4-7 天左右。鼻出血时,平均白细胞计数为 5462.96/μL(范围为 1,600 – 14,700/μL),平均血小板计数约为 30,000/μL。大多数患者白细胞计数呈下降趋势,血小板计数呈上升趋势。AST 和 ALT 升高(平均 AST 424 U/L,ALT:166 U/L)。三分之一的患者经历了额外的出血,最常见的是口腔粘膜出血,其次是胃肠道出血。总体而言,62.96% 的患者需要输血,平均血小板输注量约为 4 品脱。在其他部位出血的患者中,89% 需要输血,这凸显了该亚组的严重程度有所增加。结论 登革热患者鼻出血最常发生在疾病危重期,并与严重血小板减少、肝功能障碍和多部位出血风险增加相关。尽管并非所有患者都需要输血,但鼻出血可能作为 重症登革热 的早期临床标志,强调需要警惕监测和及时干预以预防并发症。临床试验 不适用。

analysis_zh.main_results: 共有 27 例 登革热 伴鼻出血患者接受评估,平均年龄 42 岁,70.37% 为男性。鼻出血发生在发病第 4-7 天左右,鼻出血时平均白细胞计数为 5462.96/μL,血小板计数约为 30,000/μL。AST 和 ALT 升高(平均 AST 424 U/L,ALT:166 U/L),62.96% 需要输血。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 登革热患者的鼻出血最常发生在疾病的关键阶段,并与严重的血小板减少、肝功能障碍和多部位出血风险增加有关。这项研究首次描述了尼泊尔出现鼻出血的登革热患者的临床和实验室概况。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鼻出血可能作为 重症登革热 的早期临床标志,强调需要警惕监测和及时干预以预防并发症。在其他部位出血的患者中,89% 需要输血,这凸显了该亚组的严重程度增加。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于医院记录,这可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。由于样本量小和单中心设计,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Validation of a d34 recombinant antigen‐based ELISA for monitoring protective humoral immunity to dengue virus in MVA‐d34‐immunized mice
papers.abstract: To validate an enzyme‐linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) test system for the semi‐quantitative detection of specific IgG antibodies against domain III of the E protein of dengue virus (DENV) serotypes 1–4 in mouse serum. Commercial reagent kits (JSC BTK Bioservice, Moscow, Russia) were utilised. The recombinant d34 protein expressed in a baculovirus system served as the immunosorbent. Analytical performance was evaluated using a panel of 100 serum samples from BALB/c mice (11 groups). Virusneutralising antibodies against DENV serotypes D1–D4 were determined by a virus neutralisation test in Vero cell culture.The specificity and sensitivity of the test system developed both reached 100 % (95 % CI: 91.2–100.0 %), with a critical optical density (ODcrit) of 0.16 and a coefficient of variation (CV) not exceeding 8.2 %. Stability testing at 37°C for 14 days revealed a 4.7 % signal decrease (95 % CI: –11.3 % to +1.9 %), indicating that the immunosorbent is expected to retain its functional properties for up to 12 months when stored at 2–8°C. The systematically higher ELISA values compared to neutralisation test titers reflect differences in the detected antibody pools and support the combined use of both methods for a comprehensive evaluation of the humoral immune response.The validated ELISA test system exhibits high diagnostic performance and is suitable for the semi‐quantitative determination of specific IgG antibodies against domain III of the DENV E protein in laboratory mouse serum. Its application provides a reliable tool for preclinical monitoring of vaccine candidate immunogenicity and establishes a methodological basis for standardising the quality control of biologics targeting serotypespecific epitopes.

papers.title: Potent Cross-Serotype Dengue Neutralization with Low ADE by AG-Strand-Targeting Anti-EDIII Antibodies
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) envelope protein domain III (EDIII) is a premier target for vaccine design because EDIII-specific antibodies can potently neutralize DENV with a low propensity for inducing antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). We previously identified a cross-reactive antibody, R3N_2D3, which targets the EDIII AG-strand epitope and neutralizes all four DENV serotypes with low ADE, a desirable combination of activities among anti-DENV antibodies. In this study, we expanded this AG-strand-targeting antibody panel by identifying four additional anti-EDIII antibodies from our dengue-immune single-chain variable fragment (scFv)-phage libraries. Despite variations in their binding footprints, these new antibodies converged on key residues within the AG-strand epitope. When expressed as full IgG1, these candidates showed potent cross-neutralization with subnanomolar focus reduction neutralization titers (FRNT50 values) and consistently low ADE compared to the prototypical fusion-loop antibody 4G2 when tested in an in vitro U937 monocytic cell model. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that the AG-strand epitope can elicit broadly protective antibodies with reduced ADE risk, highlighting its potential as a strategic epitope for pan-DENV vaccine development.

papers.title: Association between Nutritional Status with Severity of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever in Pediatric Patients
papers.abstract: Dengue infection remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, including Indonesia, with pediatric patients exhibiting varying degrees of clinical severity. Nutritional status has been suggested as a host-related factor influencing immune response and disease progression. This study aimed to examine the association between nutritional status and dengue severity among pediatric patients treated at Mangusada Regional Hospital in 2024 using the WHO 2009 classification system. A cross-sectional analytic design was applied using secondary data from medical records. Total sampling yielded 120 eligible pediatric dengue patients after exclusion of incomplete records. Nutritional status was assessed using BMI-for-age z-score based on WHO growth standards and categorized into undernutrition, normal nutrition, and overnutrition. Dengue severity was classified as dengue without warning signs and dengue with warning signs/severe dengue for analysis. Statistical analysis was performed using the Chi-square test with Cramér’s V to determine effect size. The results showed that overnutrition was the most frequent nutritional status (55.0%), and dengue with warning signs was the most common severity category (44.2%). Chi-square analysis indicated no statistically significant unadjusted association between nutritional status and dengue severity (χ2 = 1.50; p = 0.473), with a small effect size (Cramér’s V = 0.112). These findings should be interpreted cautiously because important potential confounding variables were not included in the analysis.
papers.journal: Qanun Medika - Medical Journal Faculty of Medicine Muhammadiyah Surabaya

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热感染仍然是包括印度尼西亚在内的热带地区的主要公共卫生问题,儿科患者表现出不同程度的临床严重程度。营养状况被认为是影响 宿主 和疾病进展的 宿主 相关因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用曼古萨达地区医院 2024 年医疗记录中的二手数据进行横断面分析设计。在排除不完整记录后,总抽样产生了 120 名符合条件的儿科登革热患者。
elements_zh.methods: 根据世界卫生组织生长标准,使用年龄别体重指数 z 评分评估营养状况,并将其分为营养不足、正常营养和营养过剩。使用卡方检验和 Cramér’s V 进行统计分析以确定效应大小。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,营养过剩是最常见的营养状况(55.0%),而有预警症状的登革热是最常见的严重程度类别(44.2%)。卡方分析表明,营养状况与登革热严重程度之间不存在统计学上显着的未经调整的关联(χ2 = 1.50;p = 0.473),且效应量较小(Cramér V = 0.112)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 应谨慎解释这些发现,因为分析中未包括重要的潜在混杂变量。该研究深入了解儿科人群的营养状况和登革热严重程度的分布。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来调查营养状况在登革热严重程度中的作用的研究提供信息,特别是在考虑混杂变量时。这可能有助于更好地对儿科登革热患者进行风险分层和管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度因排除重要的潜在混杂变量和使用未经调整的分析而受到限制。横断面设计限制了因果推断,并且研究结果可能无法推广到特定的医院人群之外。

papers.title: Concurrent Dengue, Tuberculosis Section and Secondary Haemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis in a Patient with Chronic Kidney Disease: A Case Report
papers.abstract: The co-existence of multiple infections in an immunocompromised patient makes it challenging to make a diagnosis, especially when there are overlapping clinical features. The present case report describes a 65-year-old female with longstanding chronic kidney disease who presented with prolonged fever, progressive breathlessness, and right supraclavicular lymphadenopathy. Three of the four co-existing conditions were definitively diagnosed: dengue infection was confirmed by positive serum Non-Structural Protein 1 (NS1) antigen and dengue Immunoglobulin M (IgM), tuberculous lymphadenitis by Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) and secondary Haemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) using the H-score and HLH-2024 diagnostic criteria. Community-acquired pneumonia was strongly suspected based on clinical and radiological findings. Cutaneous lesions over the anterior chest wall and upper back were consistent with scrofuloderma but were not histologically confirmed. The patient received multidisciplinary care, including Anti-Tubercular Therapy (ATT), broad-spectrum antibiotics, dexamethasone and Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIG) (for HLH), blood product transfusions and dialysis. The literature search identified reports of concurrent dengue and HLH, tuberculosis and HLH, and dengue with tuberculosis. However, there was no published case describing the simultaneous occurrence of dengue, tuberculosis, and secondary HLH in a single patient.
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF CLINICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC RESEARCH

Three of the four co-existing conditions were definitively diagnosed: dengue infection was confirmed by positive serum Non-Structural Protein 1 (NS1) antigen and dengue Immunoglobulin M (IgM), tuberculous lymphadenitis by Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) and secondary Haemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) using the H-score and HLH-2024 diagnostic criteria. Community-acquired pneumonia was strongly suspected based on clinical and radiological findings. Cutaneous lesions over the anterior chest wall and upper back were consistent with scrofuloderma but were not histologically confirmed. The patient received multidisciplinary care, including Anti-Tubercular Therapy (ATT), broad-spectrum antibiotics, dexamethasone and Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIG) (for HLH), blood product transfusions and dialysis. The literature search identified reports of concurrent dengue and HLH, tuberculosis and HLH, and dengue with tuberculosis. However, there was no published case describing the simultaneous occurrence of dengue, tuberculosis, and secondary HLH in a single patient.

papers.title: Diagnostic performance of the STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO rapid diagnostic test in a resource-limited setting: a laboratory-based evaluation in the Republic of Niger
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is an expanding public health threat in sub-Saharan Africa, yet access to laboratory-confirmed diagnosis remains severely constrained in resource-limited settings. Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer a practical alternative to molecular and serological diagnostic methods, but their performance must be validated in local epidemiological contexts before integration into national testing algorithms. We conducted a retrospective laboratory-based diagnostic accuracy study using 221 archived serum samples from suspected dengue patients admitted to public and private hospitals in Niamey between October and December 2023. The STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO (SD Biosensor) was compared against qRT-PCR (NS1 reference) and ELISA IgM (IgM reference). Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV) and negative predictive value (NPV) were calculated with 95% Wilson score confidence intervals. Performance was stratified by viral load (Ct value) and time since symptom onset. Dengue infection was confirmed in 68/221 (30.8%) samples by qRT-PCR and 69/221 (31.2%) by IgM ELISA. For NS1 detection, the STANDARDTM Q demonstrated sensitivity of 79.4% (95% CI: 68.4–87.3%) and specificity of 85.5% (95% CI: 78.0–90.7%), with sensitivity increasing to 83.8% when combined with IgM. NS1 sensitivity was highest in samples with low and moderate viral load (Ct 20–30: 100%). NS1 sensitivity was 84.4% in the acute phase (≤ 7 days) versus 57.1% in the recovery phase (> 7 days). For IgM detection, sensitivity was 49.3% (95% CI: 38.2–60.4%) but specificity was 98.6% (95% CI: 95.0–99.6%), with IgM sensitivity rising to 100% in the recovery phase. The STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO demonstrated adequate NS1 accuracy and high IgM specificity. Combined NS1 and IgM testing improves case detection across infection phases. Thus, we recommend this RDT as a first-line diagnostic tool in decentralized healthcare settings in Niger, although molecular testing remains essential for surveillance and serotyping purposes.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of the STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO rapid diagnostic test in a resource-limited setting in Niger, comparing it with qRT-PCR and ELISA IgM. Dengue fever is a growing public health threat in sub-Saharan Africa, where laboratory confirmation is limited. The study used 221 archived serum samples from suspected dengue patients admitted to hospitals in Niamey between October and December 2023. The test showed sensitivity of 79.4% for NS1 detection and 49.3% for IgM, with specificity of 85.5% and 98.6%, respectively. Sensitivity increased to 83.8% when combined with IgM, and NS1 sensitivity was highest in samples with low and moderate viral load. IgM sensitivity improved to 100% in the recovery phase. The authors recommend the RDT as a first-line tool in decentralized settings but emphasize the need for molecular testing for surveillance and serotyping. The study's findings are based on a single laboratory-based evaluation, and the evidence is limited to the acute and recovery phases of infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是撒哈拉以南非洲地区日益扩大的公共卫生威胁,但在资源有限的环境中,获得实验室确认的 诊断 仍然受到严重限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用 2023 年 10 月至 12 月期间在尼亚美公立和私立医院收治的疑似登革热患者的 221 份存档血清样本进行了一项基于实验室的回顾性诊断准确性研究。
elements_zh.methods: 将 STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO(SD 生物传感器)与 qRT-PCR(NS1 参考)和 ELISA IgM(IgM 参考)进行比较。qRT-PCR 证实 68/221 (30.8%) 样本存在登革热感染,IgM ELISA 证实 69/221 (31.2%) 样本存在登革热感染。
elements_zh.main_results: 对于 NS1 检测,STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO 的敏感性为 79.4%(95% CI:68.4–87.3%),特异性为 85.5%(95% CI:78.0–90.7%),与 IgM 结合时敏感性增加至 83.8%。NS1 敏感性在低病毒载量和中等病毒载量的样本中最高(Ct 20-30:100%)。急性期(≤ 7 天)的 NS1 敏感性为 84.4%,而恢复期(> 7 天)的 NS1 敏感性为 57.1%。对于 IgM 检测,敏感性为 49.3%(95% CI:38.2–60.4%),但特异性为 98.6%(95% CI:95.0–99.6%),IgM 敏感性在恢复阶段升至 100%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: STANDARDTM Q Dengue DUO 表现出足够的 NS1 准确性和高 IgM 特异性。NS1 和 IgM 联合检测可改善整个感染阶段的病例检测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 因此,我们建议将此 RDT 作为尼日尔分散医疗机构中的一线诊断工具,尽管分子检测对于 监测 和血清分型目的仍然至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 根据病毒载量(Ct 值)和症状出现后的时间对表现进行分层。提供的证据并未报告研究设计的局限性。

papers.title: LocoTrackAI: Advanced convolutional neural network-based tool for monitoring locomotor activity in dengue-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes
papers.abstract: Abstract Monitoring the locomotor activity of mosquitoes is vital for understanding their behavioral patterns and role in disease transmission. Studies investigating the locomotor activity of dengue-infected mosquitoes have faced several limitations, including confining mosquitoes within small tubes that restrict natural movement, discontinuous recordings that fail to provide detailed activity patterns, and the lack of open-source tools to effectively monitor mosquito locomotor activity. Here, we present LocoTrackAI, a robust artificial intelligence-based tool that leverages a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a multi-object tracking algorithm to comprehensively analyze the locomotor activity of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes from videos recorded using standard laboratory cages. LocoTrackAI automatically processes video datasets, tracks individual mosquito identities, and provides detailed locomotion results for both individual mosquitoes and group activity, including spatial distributions, movement patterns, heat maps, and activity ratios. The tool features a Skip Frame function to improve computational efficiency, adjustable movement thresholds for customized sensitivity, and a user-friendly interface that supports unsupervised batch processing, ensuring accuracy and flexibility for diverse research applications. The LocoTrackAI achieved 99.91% accuracy with a low centroid detection error of 0.22 pixels across 36,020 frames and demonstrated a 93.23% success rate in reassigning identities during 207 post-occlusion instances. Using LocoTrackAI, we analyzed the locomotor activity of dengue-infected and noninfected mosquitoes across 3.24 million recorded mosquito positions. Results revealed that infected mosquitoes exhibited significantly higher locomotor activity (p = 0.0009), with 95,726 movements (0.30 mean locomotor activity) compared to 42,173 movements (0.13 mean locomotor activity) in noninfected mosquitoes, representing more than 200% of the activity of noninfected mosquitoes. Additionally, spatial analysis indicated a more extensive and uniform distribution for infected mosquitoes, with entropy values of 3.38 for infected and 3.13 for noninfected mosquitoes. These findings suggest that dengue infection increases locomotor activity and spatial exploration, potentially enhancing the mosquitoes' capacity to locate hosts and spread the virus. Future studies could expand on this work by investigating the locomotor effects of other arboviruses and further developing tools to automate the analysis of feeding and other critical behaviors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 监测蚊子的运动活动对于了解其行为模式和在疾病 传播 中的作用至关重要。调查感染登革热的蚊子的运动活动的研究面临着一些限制,包括将蚊子限制在限制自然运动的小管内、无法提供详细活动模式的不连续记录以及缺乏有效监测蚊子运动活动的开源工具。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: Here, we present LocoTrackAI, a robust artificial intelligence-based tool that leverages a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a multi-object tracking algorithm to comprehensively analyze the locomotor activity of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes from videos recorded using standard laboratory cages. elements_zh.methods: LocoTrackAI 自动处理视频数据集,跟踪个体蚊子身份,并提供个体蚊子和群体活动的详细运动结果,包括空间分布、运动模式、热图和活动比率。该工具具有跳帧功能,可提高计算效率,可调节移动阈值以定制灵敏度,以及支持无监督批处理的用户友好界面,确保各种研究应用的准确性和灵活性。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: LocoTrackAI的开发为监测蚊子行为提供了强大的工具,可以增强对登革热传播动态的了解并为媒介控制策略提供信息。感染登革热的蚊子运动活动的增加凸显了有针对性的干预措施减少蚊子-宿主 接触和疾病传播的潜力。

The LocoTrackAI achieved 99.91% accuracy with a low centroid detection error of 0.22 pixels across 36,020 frames and demonstrated a 93.23% success rate in reassigning identities during 207 post-occlusion instances. Using LocoTrackAI, we analyzed the locomotor activity of dengue-infected and noninfected mosquitoes across 3.24 million recorded mosquito positions. Results revealed that infected mosquitoes exhibited significantly higher locomotor activity (p = 0.0009), with 95,726 movements (0.30 mean locomotor activity) compared to 42,173 movements (0.13 mean locomotor activity) in noninfected mosquitoes, representing more than 200% of the activity of noninfected mosquitoes. Additionally, spatial analysis indicated a more extensive and uniform distribution for infected mosquitoes, with entropy values of 3.38 for infected and 3.13 for noninfected mosquitoes. These findings suggest that dengue infection increases locomotor activity and spatial exploration, potentially enhancing the mosquitoes' capacity to locate hosts and spread the virus. Future studies could expand on this work by investigating the locomotor effects of other arboviruses and further developing tools to automate the analysis of feeding and other critical behaviors.

analysis_zh.methods: LocoTrackAI 自动处理视频数据集,跟踪个体蚊子身份,并提供个体蚊子和群体活动的详细运动结果,包括空间分布、运动模式、热图和活动比率。该工具具有跳帧功能,可提高计算效率,可调节移动阈值以定制灵敏度,以及支持无监督批处理的用户友好界面,确保各种研究应用的准确性和灵活性。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,登革热感染增加了运动活动和空间探索,可能增强蚊子定位 宿主 和传播病毒的能力。未来的研究可以通过调查其他虫媒病毒的运动效应并进一步开发自动分析进食和其他关键行为的工具来扩展这项工作。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: LocoTrackAI的开发为监测蚊子行为提供了强大的工具,可以增强对登革热传播动态的了解并为媒介控制策略提供信息。感染登革热的蚊子运动活动的增加凸显了有针对性的干预措施减少蚊子-宿主 接触和疾病传播的潜力。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在实验室环境中使用标准笼子进行的,这可能无法完全复制自然环境条件。尽管准确性和统计显着性很高,但由于报告仅具有摘要性质并且需要在现场环境中进一步验证,因此证据强度适中。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal Distribution and Relative Risk of Dengue Fever in Peninsular Malaysia
papers.abstract: Objectives: Dengue fever remains a major public health concern in Malaysia, with marked spatial heterogeneity and evolving temporal dynamics. Although the incidence of dengue has increased substantially in recent years, district-level risk patterns and their changes over time remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to assess the spatio-temporal distribution of dengue risk in Peninsular Malaysia.Methods: A retrospective analysis of dengue surveillance data was conducted using district-level monthly case counts from 2022 to 2024. Dengue risk was modeled with Bayesian spatio-temporal models incorporating spatial effects, temporal effects, and space–time interaction terms. Spatial variation was modeled using the Besag–York–Mollié 2 specification, while temporal trends were modeled using a first-order random walk. Competing models were compared using the deviance information criterion (DIC) and Watanabe–Akaike information criterion (WAIC). Relative risk (RR) and exceedance probability maps were generated from the best-fitting model.Results: Dengue incidence increased markedly after 2022, with incidence rates nearly doubling in 2023 and remaining high in 2024. Incidence maps showed pronounced spatial heterogeneity, with persistent high-incidence districts concentrated in urban and peri-urban regions. Spatio-temporal models incorporating space–time interaction substantially outperformed the additive model, with lower DIC and WAIC values. The best-fitting model identified the highest RRs in districts within Selangor, while several districts in Penang, and Johor had high posterior probabilities of elevated risk [P(RR>1)>0.8].Conclusions: This study demonstrates substantial spatial heterogeneity and evolving temporal dynamics in dengue risk across Peninsular Malaysia. Bayesian spatio-temporal disease mapping provides robust, localized, time-specific estimates of dengue risk and may support targeted surveillance and intervention in endemic settings.
papers.journal: Journal of Preventive Medicine and Public Health

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:登革热 仍然是马来西亚的一个主要公共卫生问题,具有明显的空间异质性和不断变化的时间动态。尽管近年来登革热的 发病率 大幅增加,但地区级风险模式及其随时间的变化仍然没有充分表征。本研究旨在评估马来西亚半岛登革热风险的时空分布。方法:利用 2022 年至 2024 年地区级每月病例数对登革热 监测 数据进行回顾性分析。登革热风险采用贝叶斯时空模型建模,结合了空间效应、时间效应和时空相互作用项。空间变化使用 Besag-York-Mollié 2 规范进行建模,而时间趋势则使用一阶随机游走进行建模。使用偏差信息准则(DIC)和渡边-赤池信息准则(WAIC)对竞争模型进行了比较。根据最佳拟合模型生成相对风险 (RR) 和超越概率图。结果:登革热 发病率 率在 2022 年之后显着增加,2023 年 发病率 率几乎翻倍,并在 2024 年保持较高水平。发病率 地图显示出明显的空间异质性,持续高 发病率 地区集中在城市和城郊地区。结合时空相互作用的时空模型大大优于加法模型,具有较低的 DIC 和 WAIC 值。最佳拟合模型确定了雪兰莪州内各地区的最高 RR,而槟城和柔佛州的几个地区的风险升高后验概率较高 [P(RR>1)>0.8]。结论:这项研究表明,马来西亚半岛登革热风险存在显着的空间异质性和不断变化的时间动态。贝叶斯时空疾病图谱提供了对登革热风险的稳健、局部、特定时间的估计,并可能支持有针对性的 监测 和流行病环境中的干预。

papers.title: Dynamical Effects of Homologous Reinfections in a Multi-Strain Dengue Model
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue transmission is shaped by multiple viral serotypes, temporary cross-immunity (TCI), antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), and repeated exposure in endemic populations. Classical multi-strain models usually assume lifelong protection against reinfection with the same serotype. However, recent evidence suggests that homologous dengue reinfections, although rare, can occur. Their population-level consequences remain poorly understood. We extend a two-infection, two-strain dengue model with TCI and ADE-mediated transmission differences to include homologous reinfections. Homologous reinfection is represented by two exploratory parameters: relative susceptibility to reinfection with the same serotype and relative infectiousness during homologous reinfection. Using equilibrium analysis, bifurcation diagrams, simulations, and phase-space projections, we examine how these parameters affect dengue dynamics and interact with TCI duration and seasonal forcing under intermediate and long TCI durations, with and without seasonality. The extended model shows that qualitative dynamics characteristic of endemic dengue transmission are reproduced mainly when susceptibility to homologous reinfection is low, so that homologous reinfections remain rare but dynamically influential. Longer TCI broadens regions of complex oscillatory dynamics, while seasonality shifts the bifurcation structure and makes torus bifurcations a central route to complex behavior. Although backward bifurcation can occur when homologous susceptibility exceeds the biologically meaningful range, this result should be interpreted as a mathematical mechanism rather than a realistic dengue scenario. These results indicate that rare homologous reinfection pathways can influence long-term dengue dynamics when interacting with immune history, TCI, ADE-mediated transmission differences, and seasonal variation. Incorporating such pathways may improve understanding of recurrent outbreaks and irregular incidence patterns in highly exposed populations.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the poorly understood population-level consequences of homologous dengue reinfections, which are rare but occur, challenging classical multi-strain models that assume lifelong protection against reinfection with the same serotype.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study extends a two-infection, two-strain dengue model with temporary cross-immunity and antibody-dependent enhancement to include homologous reinfections, examining their effects on dengue dynamics under various conditions.
analysis.methods: Using equilibrium analysis, bifurcation diagrams, simulations, and phase-space projections, the study examines how parameters for susceptibility to homologous reinfection and infectiousness during such reinfections interact with temporary cross-immunity duration and seasonal forcing.
analysis.main_results: The extended model reproduces endemic dengue dynamics mainly when susceptibility to homologous reinfection is low, making reinfections rare but dynamically influential; longer temporary cross-immunity broadens regions of complex oscillatory dynamics, while seasonality shifts bifurcation structure.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that rare homologous reinfection pathways can influence long-term dengue dynamics when interacting with immune history, temporary cross-immunity, antibody-dependent enhancement-mediated transmission differences, and seasonal variation, representing a novel understanding of recurrent outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Incorporating homologous reinfection pathways may improve understanding of recurrent outbreaks and irregular incidence patterns in highly exposed populations, informing surveillance and intervention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on mathematical modeling rather than empirical data; backward bifurcation results are interpreted as mathematical mechanisms rather than realistic dengue scenarios, limiting generalizability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the dynamical effects of homologous reinfections in a multi-strain dengue model, challenging classical assumptions of lifelong protection. By extending a model with temporary cross-immunity and antibody-dependent enhancement to include homologous reinfections, the research finds that rare reinfections can significantly influence long-term dengue dynamics when interacting with immune history and seasonal variation. The model shows that low susceptibility to homologous reinfection is key to reproducing endemic dynamics, while longer temporary cross-immunity and seasonality affect oscillatory patterns. These insights improve understanding of recurrent outbreaks and irregular incidence patterns in endemic populations, though the mathematical nature of the study limits direct empirical applicability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了人们对同源登革热再感染的人群水平后果知之甚少的问题,这种情况很少见,但却发生过,这对假设终身保护免受相同血清型再感染的经典多菌株模型提出了挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究扩展了具有临时交叉免疫和 抗体依赖性增强 的两种感染、两种菌株登革热模型,以包括同源再感染,检查它们在各种条件下对登革热动态的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用平衡分析、分岔图、模拟和相空间投影,研究了同源再感染的易感性参数和再感染期间的传染性如何与临时交叉免疫持续时间和季节性强迫相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 扩展模型主要在同源再感染的敏感性较低时再现地方性登革热动态,使得再感染很少但具有动态影响;较长的临时交叉免疫拓宽了复杂振荡动力学的区域,而季节性则改变了分叉结构。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,罕见的同源再感染途径在与免疫史、临时交叉免疫、抗体依赖性增强 介导的 抗体依赖性增强 差异和季节变化相互作用时,可以影响长期登革热动态,代表了对复发性 暴发 的新理解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 纳入同源再感染途径可能会提高对高度暴露人群中复发性 暴发 和不规则 发病率 模式的理解,从而为 监测 和干预策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于数学模型而不是经验数据;向后分岔结果被解释为数学机制而不是现实的登革热场景,限制了普遍性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热 传播 是由多种病毒血清型、暂时交叉免疫 (TCI)、抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 以及流行人群中的反复暴露形成的。经典的多菌株模型通常假设终身保护免受相同血清型的再次感染。然而,最近的证据表明,同源登革热再感染虽然罕见,但却可能发生。它们对人口层面的影响仍然知之甚少。我们利用 TCI 和 ADE 介导的 传播 差异扩展了两种感染、两种菌株的登革热模型,以包括同源再感染。同源再感染由两个探索性参数表示:对相同血清型再感染的相对易感性和同源再感染期间的相对传染性。使用平衡分析、分岔图、模拟和相空间投影,我们研究了这些参数如何影响登革热动力学,以及在中等和长期 TCI 持续时间(有或没有季节性)下与 TCI 持续时间和季节性强迫相互作用。扩展模型表明,地方性登革热传播的定性动态特征主要在同源再感染的易感性较低时再现,因此同源再感染仍然很少见,但具有动态影响。较长的 TCI 拓宽了复杂振荡动力学的区域,而季节性改变了分叉结构,并使环面分叉成为复杂行为的中心路径。尽管当同源敏感性超出生物学意义范围时可能会发生后向分叉,但该结果应解释为数学机制而不是现实的登革热场景。这些结果表明,当与免疫史、TCI、ADE 介导的 传播 差异和季节变化相互作用时,罕见的同源再感染途径可以影响长期登革热动态。纳入此类途径可能会提高对高度暴露人群中复发性 暴发 和不规则 发病率 模式的理解。

papers.title: HUBUNGAN 3M, OBAT NYAMUK DENGAN KEJADIAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE DI PUSKESMAS DEMPO PALEMBANG The Relationship Between the "3M" Measures, Mosquito Repellents, and the Incidence of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever at the Dempo Community Health Center, Palembang
papers.abstract: ABSTRAK Demam berdarah dengue (DBD) adalah penyakit menular akibat infeksi virus dengue yang ditularkan melalui gigitan nyamuk Aedes aegypti. Penyakit ini masih menjadi masalah kesehatan yang cukup serius karena dapat menimbulkan kondisi fatal bahkan menyebabkan kematian apabila tidak segera ditangani. Pencegahan sederhana dapat dilakukan dengan perilaku 3M, yakni menguras tempat penampungan air, menutup wadah air agar tidak menjadi sarang nyamuk, serta memanfaatkan atau mendaur ulang barang bekas. Selain itu, penggunaan obat nyamuk juga dianggap efektif untuk menurunkan risiko gigitan nyamuk penyebab DBD. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengetahui hubungan antara perilaku 3M dan kebiasaan penggunaan obat nyamuk dengan kejadian DBD di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Dempo Kota Palembang tahun 2025. Jenis penelitian menggunakan pendekatan analitik observasional dengan desain cross sectional. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 30 responden yang ditentukan melalui teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan dengan kuesioner dan observasi, lalu dianalisis menggunakan uji chi-square. Diperoleh hasil bahwa terdapat hubungan signifikan antara perilaku 3M dengan kejadian DBD (p-value 0,001 < 0,05). Begitu pula penggunaan obat nyamuk terbukti berhubungan signifikan dengan kejadian DBD (p-value 0,0002 < 0,05). Konsistensi dalam menerapkan perilaku 3M disertai penggunaan obat nyamuk dapat menurunkan risiko DBD. Masyarakat diharapkan lebih sadar serta disiplin dalam menjalankan langkah pencegahan.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD) is a serious infectious disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that can be fatal if not promptly treated. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between the "3M" prevention measures and mosquito repellent use with the incidence of DBD in the Dempo Community Health Center area, Palembang.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An observational analytic study with a cross-sectional design was conducted in 2025 at the Dempo Community Health Center, Palembang, involving 30 respondents selected through purposive sampling.
analysis.methods: Data were collected using questionnaires and observation, and analyzed using the chi-square test to determine the significance of associations between preventive behaviors and DBD incidence.
analysis.main_results: A significant association was found between "3M" behavior and DBD incidence (p-value 0.001 < 0.05), and between mosquito repellent use and DBD incidence (p-value 0.0002 < 0.05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that consistent application of "3M" measures combined with mosquito repellent use can reduce the risk of DBD, emphasizing the importance of community awareness and discipline in prevention.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the importance of promoting "3M" behaviors and mosquito repellent use as effective strategies for dengue prevention in community health settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size (30 respondents) and the cross-sectional design, which limits causal inference.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between "3M" prevention measures (draining water containers, covering water storage, and recycling unused items) and mosquito repellent use with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DBD) incidence in Palembang. Using a cross-sectional design with 30 respondents, data were collected via questionnaires and observation, analyzed with chi-square tests. Significant associations were found between "3M" behavior (p=0.001) and mosquito repellent use (p=0.0002) with DBD incidence. The authors concluded that consistent "3M" practices combined with repellent use can reduce DBD risk, highlighting the need for community awareness and discipline in prevention. The study provides practical insights for dengue control programs, though its small sample size limits generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革出血热(DBD)是一种由埃及伊蚊传播的严重传染病,如果不及时治疗可能致命。本研究旨在调查巨港 Dempo 社区卫生中心地区的“3M”预防措施与 DBD 发病率 驱蚊剂使用之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年,巨港 Dempo 社区健康中心进行了一项采用横断面设计的观察分析研究,涉及通过有目的抽样选出的 30 名受访者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过问卷调查和观察收集数据,并使用卡方检验进行分析,以确定预防行为与 DBD 发病率 之间关联的显着性。
elements_zh.main_results: 发现“3M”行为与 DBD 发病率(p 值 0.001 < 0.05)之间以及驱蚊剂的使用与 DBD 发病率 之间(p 值 0.0002 < 0.05)之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,持续应用“3M”措施并结合使用驱蚊剂可以降低 DBD 的风险,强调社区意识和纪律在预防中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持了促进“3M”行为和使用驱蚊剂作为社区卫生环境中预防登革热的有效策略的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量较小(30 名受访者)和横截面设计,证据强度中等,限制了因果推断。

papers.title: Laporan Kasus: Demam Berdarah Dengue dengan Perdarahan Saluran Cerna pada Pasien Anak Usia 9 Tahun disertai Bisitopenia dengan Dugaan Leukemia Limfoblastik Akut
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) remains a major cause of pediatric hospitalization in tropical countries and may progress to severe disease with plasma leakage, hemorrhage, and circulatory shock. However, profound cytopenia accompanied by atypical findings on peripheral blood smear is uncommon in uncomplicated dengue infection and should prompt further evaluation for underlying hematologic disorders. This case report aims to describe the clinical course of a pediatric patient with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and severe bicytopenia suggestive of acute leukemia, illustrating the diagnostic challenge atypical hematological manifestations during the initial assessment. A retrospective case report was conducted using the patient's medical records, including clinical history, physical examination, laboratory investigations, treatment, and clinical outcomes. The findings were descriptively analyzed and interpreted in the context of current evidence regarding severe dengue and pediatric hematologic malignancies. A 9-year-old girl presented with a five-day history of intermittent fever accompanied by nausea, vomiting, headache, epistaxis, generalized weakness, and melena. Laboratory evaluation demonstrated severe anemia (hemoglobin 4.49 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (34 × 103/μL), progressive leukopenia, and peripheral blood smear findings of atypical mononuclear cells and smudge cells. The patient was diagnosed with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and received intravenous fluid resuscitation, packed red blood cell transfusion, platelet concentrate transfusion, and supportive therapy. Despite intensive management, she developed refractory shock, generalized seizures, respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest. Cardiopulmonary resuscitation was unsuccessful, and the patient died within 24 hours of hospitalization. The combination of profound bicytopenia and abnormal peripheral blood smear findings raised a strong suspicion of an underlying acute hematologic malignancy, although definitive confirmation by bone marrow examination could not be performed because of the rapid clinical deterioration. Severe anemia and bicytopenia in pediatric patients with DHF represent atypical findings that warrant comprehensive evaluation beyond dengue-related complications. Early recognition of hematological abnormalities suggestive of an underlying hematologic malignancy may facilitate timely diagnostic investigation and optimize clinical management in similar cases. Keywords: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever, Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Bicytopenia, Acute Leukemia, Pediatric Case Report. ABSTRAK Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi salah satu penyebab utama rawat inap pada anak di negara tropis. Pada sebagian kasus, penyakit dapat berkembang menjadi dengue berat yang ditandai dengan kebocoran plasma, perdarahan, dan syok. Adanya sitopenia berat yang tidak sesuai dengan gambaran klinis dengue pada umumnya perlu mendapat perhatian karena dapat mengindikasikan adanya kelainan hematologi yang mendasari. Melaporkan perjalanan klinis pasien anak dengan DBD disertai perdarahan saluran cerna dan bisitopenia yang mengarah pada suspek leukemia akut, serta menekankan pentingnya evaluasi lebih lanjut pada pasien dengan manifestasi hematologi yang tidak khas. Laporan kasus ini disusun secara retrospektif berdasarkan data rekam medis pasien yang meliputi anamnesis, pemeriksaan fisik, pemeriksaan penunjang, tata laksana, dan luaran klinis selama perawatan. Data dianalisis secara deskriptif dan dibandingkan dengan literatur terkini mengenai dengue berat dan keganasan hematologi pada anak. Seorang anak perempuan berusia 9 tahun datang dengan keluhan demam sejak lima hari sebelum masuk rumah sakit yang disertai mual, muntah, nyeri kepala, epistaksis, badan lemas, dan melena. Pemeriksaan laboratorium menunjukkan anemia berat dengan kadar hemoglobin 4,49 g/dL, trombositopenia 34.000/μL, leukopenia progresif, serta gambaran darah tepi berupa sel mononuklear atipik dan smudge cells. Pasien didiagnosis DBD dengan perdarahan saluran cerna dan mendapatkan terapi cairan intravena, transfusi packed red cells(PRC), transfusi trombosit konsentrat, serta terapi suportif lainnya. Selama perawatan, kondisi pasien memburuk dengan terjadinya syok refrakter, kejang umum, gagal nafas, dan henti jantung. Resusitasi jantung paru tidak memberikan respons sehingga pasien dinyatakan meninggal dunia. Adanya bisitopenia berat yang disertai temuan sel atipik pada darah tepi menimbulkan kecurigaan kuat terhadap keganasan hematologi berupa leukemia akut, meskipun konfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan sumsum tulang belum sempat dilakukan karena perburukan klinis yang cepat. Anemia berat dan bisitopenia pada pasien anak dengan DBD merupakan temuan yang tidak lazim dan memerlukan evaluasi lebih lanjut terhadap kemungkinan kelainan hematologi yang mendasari. Pengenalan dini terhadap temuan laboratorium yang tidak sesuai dengan perjalanan klinis dengue dapat membantu mempercepat penegakan diagnosis dan menentukan strategi penatalaksanaan yang lebih komprehensif. Kata Kunci: Demam Berdarah Dengue, Perdarahan Saluran Cerna, Bisitopenia, Leukemia Akut, Laporan Kasus.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a leading cause of pediatric hospitalization in tropical regions and can progress to severe disease with hemorrhage and circulatory shock. The study highlights that profound cytopenia with atypical peripheral blood smear findings is uncommon in uncomplicated dengue and may indicate underlying hematologic disorders.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective case report was conducted using a single pediatric patient's medical records, including clinical history, physical examination, laboratory investigations, treatment, and clinical outcomes. The patient was a 9-year-old girl with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and bicytopenia.
analysis.methods: The study descriptively analyzed the patient's clinical course and laboratory findings in the context of current evidence on severe dengue and pediatric hematologic malignancies. No bone marrow examination was performed due to rapid clinical deterioration.
analysis.main_results: Laboratory evaluation revealed severe anemia (hemoglobin 4.49 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (34 × 103/μL), progressive leukopenia, and peripheral blood smear findings of atypical mononuclear cells and smudge cells. Despite intensive management, the patient developed refractory shock, generalized seizures, respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest, leading to death within 24 hours of hospitalization.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the profound bicytopenia and atypical peripheral blood smear findings as strongly suggestive of an underlying acute hematologic malignancy, though definitive confirmation was not possible. The novelty lies in illustrating the diagnostic challenge posed by atypical hematological manifestations in severe dengue.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for early recognition of hematological abnormalities in pediatric DHF cases to facilitate timely diagnostic investigation and optimize clinical management. This case underscores the importance of comprehensive evaluation beyond dengue-related complications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single retrospective case report, which restricts generalizability and precludes causal inference. The lack of bone marrow examination due to rapid clinical deterioration further constrains the strength of the conclusions. The study is rated as low confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective case report describes a 9-year-old girl with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and severe bicytopenia, including atypical peripheral blood smear findings. Laboratory results showed severe anemia (hemoglobin 4.49 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (34 × 103/μL), and progressive leukopenia. Despite intensive supportive therapy, the patient developed refractory shock, seizures, respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest, resulting in death within 24 hours. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge posed by profound cytopenia and atypical hematological features in DHF, which raised suspicion for an underlying acute leukemia, though definitive confirmation was not possible. The study emphasizes the need for early recognition of such atypical manifestations to guide comprehensive diagnostic evaluation and management in pediatric dengue cases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革出血热 (DHF) 是热带地区儿科住院的主要原因,可发展为伴有出血和循环休克的严重疾病。该研究强调,在无并发症的登革热中,严重的血细胞减少和非典型外周血涂片检查结果并不常见,可能表明存在潜在的血液系统疾病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用单个儿科患者的病历进行回顾性 病例报告,包括临床病史、体检、实验室检查、治疗 和临床结果。患者为一名9岁女孩,患有DHF并发消化道出血和双细胞减少。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究在 重症登革热 和儿童血液恶性肿瘤的当前证据背景下描述性分析了患者的临床病程和实验室检查结果。由于临床迅速恶化,未进行骨髓检查。
elements_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示严重贫血(血红蛋白4.49 g/dL)、血小板减少(34 × 103/μL)、进行性白细胞减少,以及外周血涂片发现非典型单核细胞和涂抹细胞。尽管进行了强化治疗,患者仍发展为难治性休克、全身性癫痫发作、呼吸衰竭和心脏骤停,在住院后24小时内死亡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将严重的双细胞减少和非典型外周血涂片结果解释为强烈提示潜在的急性血液恶性肿瘤,尽管不可能进行明确的确认。新颖之处在于阐明了 重症登革热 中非典型血液学表现所带来的诊断挑战。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要及早识别儿科 DHF 病例的血液学异常,以促进及时的诊断调查和优化临床管理。该病例强调了除登革热相关并发症之外的综合评估的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单一回顾性 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推断。由于临床迅速恶化而缺乏骨髓检查进一步限制了结论的强度。该研究被评为低可信度。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective case report was conducted using a single pediatric patient's medical records, including clinical history, physical examination, laboratory investigations, treatment, and clinical outcomes. The patient was a 9-year-old girl with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and bicytopenia.
analysis_en.methods: The study descriptively analyzed the patient's clinical course and laboratory findings in the context of current evidence on severe dengue and pediatric hematologic malignancies. No bone marrow examination was performed due to rapid clinical deterioration.
analysis_en.main_results: Laboratory evaluation revealed severe anemia (hemoglobin 4.49 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (34 × 103/μL), progressive leukopenia, and peripheral blood smear findings of atypical mononuclear cells and smudge cells. Despite intensive management, the patient developed refractory shock, generalized seizures, respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest, leading to death within 24 hours of hospitalization.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the profound bicytopenia and atypical peripheral blood smear findings as strongly suggestive of an underlying acute hematologic malignancy, though definitive confirmation was not possible. The novelty lies in illustrating the diagnostic challenge posed by atypical hematological manifestations in severe dengue.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for early recognition of hematological abnormalities in pediatric DHF cases to facilitate timely diagnostic investigation and optimize clinical management. This case underscores the importance of comprehensive evaluation beyond dengue-related complications.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single retrospective case report, which restricts generalizability and precludes causal inference. The lack of bone marrow examination due to rapid clinical deterioration further constrains the strength of the conclusions. The study is rated as low confidence.

papers.title_zh: 病例报告:一名9岁儿童患者出现登革热伴消化道出血,并伴有疑似急性淋巴细胞白血病导致的全血细胞减少
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) remains a major cause of pediatric hospitalization in tropical countries and may progress to severe disease with plasma leakage, hemorrhage, and circulatory shock. However, profound cytopenia accompanied by atypical findings on peripheral blood smear is uncommon in uncomplicated dengue infection and should prompt further evaluation for underlying hematologic disorders. This case report aims to describe the clinical course of a pediatric patient with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and severe bicytopenia suggestive of acute leukemia, illustrating the diagnostic challenge atypical hematological manifestations during the initial assessment. A retrospective case report was conducted using the patient's medical records, including clinical history, physical examination, laboratory investigations, treatment, and clinical outcomes. The findings were descriptively analyzed and interpreted in the context of current evidence regarding severe dengue and pediatric hematologic malignancies. A 9-year-old girl presented with a five-day history of intermittent fever accompanied by nausea, vomiting, headache, epistaxis, generalized weakness, and melena. Laboratory evaluation demonstrated severe anemia (hemoglobin 4.49 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (34 × 103/μL), progressive leukopenia, and peripheral blood smear findings of atypical mononuclear cells and smudge cells. The patient was diagnosed with DHF complicated by gastrointestinal bleeding and received intravenous fluid resuscitation, packed red blood cell transfusion, platelet concentrate transfusion, and supportive therapy. Despite intensive management, she developed refractory shock, generalized seizures, respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest. Cardiopulmonary resuscitation was unsuccessful, and the patient died within 24 hours of hospitalization. The combination of profound bicytopenia and abnormal peripheral blood smear findings raised a strong suspicion of an underlying acute hematologic malignancy, although definitive confirmation by bone marrow examination could not be performed because of the rapid clinical deterioration. Severe anemia and bicytopenia in pediatric patients with DHF represent atypical findings that warrant comprehensive evaluation beyond dengue-related complications. Early recognition of hematological abnormalities suggestive of an underlying hematologic malignancy may facilitate timely diagnostic investigation and optimize clinical management in similar cases. Keywords: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever, Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Bicytopenia, Acute Leukemia, Pediatric Case Report. ABSTRAK Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi salah satu penyebab utama rawat inap pada anak di negara tropis. Pada sebagian kasus, penyakit dapat berkembang menjadi dengue berat yang ditandai dengan kebocoran plasma, perdarahan, dan syok. Adanya sitopenia berat yang tidak sesuai dengan gambaran klinis dengue pada umumnya perlu mendapat perhatian karena dapat mengindikasikan adanya kelainan hematologi yang mendasari. Melaporkan perjalanan klinis pasien anak dengan DBD disertai perdarahan saluran cerna dan bisitopenia yang mengarah pada suspek leukemia akut, serta menekankan pentingnya evaluasi lebih lanjut pada pasien dengan manifestasi hematologi yang tidak khas. Laporan kasus ini disusun secara retrospektif berdasarkan data rekam medis pasien yang meliputi anamnesis, pemeriksaan fisik, pemeriksaan penunjang, tata laksana, dan luaran klinis selama perawatan. Data dianalisis secara deskriptif dan dibandingkan dengan literatur terkini mengenai dengue berat dan keganasan hematologi pada anak. Seorang anak perempuan berusia 9 tahun datang dengan keluhan demam sejak lima hari sebelum masuk rumah sakit yang disertai mual, muntah, nyeri kepala, epistaksis, badan lemas, dan melena. Pemeriksaan laboratorium menunjukkan anemia berat dengan kadar hemoglobin 4,49 g/dL, trombositopenia 34.000/μL, leukopenia progresif, serta gambaran darah tepi berupa sel mononuklear atipik dan smudge cells. Pasien didiagnosis DBD dengan perdarahan saluran cerna dan mendapatkan terapi cairan intravena, transfusi packed red cells(PRC), transfusi trombosit konsentrat, serta terapi suportif lainnya. Selama perawatan, kondisi pasien memburuk dengan terjadinya syok refrakter, kejang umum, gagal nafas, dan henti jantung. Resusitasi jantung paru tidak memberikan respons sehingga pasien dinyatakan meninggal dunia. Adanya bisitopenia berat yang disertai temuan sel atipik pada darah tepi menimbulkan kecurigaan kuat terhadap keganasan hematologi berupa leukemia akut, meskipun konfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan sumsum tulang belum sempat dilakukan karena perburukan klinis yang cepat. Anemia berat dan bisitopenia pada pasien anak dengan DBD merupakan temuan yang tidak lazim dan memerlukan evaluasi lebih lanjut terhadap kemungkinan kelainan hematologi yang mendasari. Pengenalan dini terhadap temuan laboratorium yang tidak sesuai dengan perjalanan klinis dengue dapat membantu mempercepat penegakan diagnosis dan menentukan strategi penatalaksanaan yang lebih komprehensif. Kata Kunci: Demam Berdarah Dengue, Perdarahan Saluran Cerna, Bisitopenia, Leukemia Akut, Laporan Kasus.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革出血热 (DHF) 是热带地区儿科住院的主要原因,可发展为伴有出血和循环休克的严重疾病。该研究强调,在无并发症的登革热中,严重的血细胞减少和非典型外周血涂片检查结果并不常见,可能表明存在潜在的血液系统疾病。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用单个儿科患者的病历进行回顾性 病例报告,包括临床病史、体检、实验室检查、治疗 和临床结果。患者为一名9岁女孩,患有DHF并发消化道出血和双细胞减少。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究在 重症登革热 和儿童血液恶性肿瘤的当前证据背景下描述性分析了患者的临床病程和实验室检查结果。由于临床迅速恶化,未进行骨髓检查。
analysis_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示严重贫血(血红蛋白4.49 g/dL)、血小板减少(34 × 103/μL)、进行性白细胞减少,以及外周血涂片发现非典型单核细胞和涂抹细胞。尽管进行了强化治疗,患者仍发展为难治性休克、全身性癫痫发作、呼吸衰竭和心脏骤停,在住院后24小时内死亡。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将严重的双细胞减少和非典型外周血涂片结果解释为强烈提示潜在的急性血液恶性肿瘤,尽管不可能进行明确的确认。新颖之处在于阐明了 重症登革热 中非典型血液学表现所带来的诊断挑战。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要及早识别儿科 DHF 病例的血液学异常,以促进及时的诊断调查和优化临床管理。该病例强调了除登革热相关并发症之外的综合评估的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单一回顾性 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推断。由于临床迅速恶化而缺乏骨髓检查进一步限制了结论的强度。该研究被评为低可信度。

papers.title: Edukasi dan pelatihan PEMBERDAYAAN MASYARAKAT MELALUI PRODUKSI OBAT NYAMUK HERBAL BERBASIS DAUN SERAI PENCEGAHAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD) PEMBERDAYAAN MASYARAKAT MELALUI PRODUKSI OBAT NYAMUK HERBAL BERBASIS DAUN SERAI PENCEGAHAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD)
papers.abstract: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat di Kota Batam, khususnya wilayah pesisir Pulau Kasu, Kecamatan Belakang Padang, akibat keterbatasan akses layanan kesehatan dan tingginya ketergantungan terhadap obat nyamuk sintetis berbahan diklorvos dan DEET yang berisiko menimbulkan resistensi vektor serta gangguan kesehatan penggunanya. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat (PKM) ini bertujuan meningkatkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan masyarakat pesisir dalam memproduksi obat nyamuk herbal berbasis daun serai (Cymbopogon nardus L.) sebagai alternatif pencegahan DBD yang aman, murah, dan berkelanjutan. Kegiatan dilaksanakan pada 9 Mei 2026 di Pulau Kasu, Kota Batam, dengan sasaran 30 peserta yang terdiri atas ibu-ibu PKK, kader posyandu, dan Karang Taruna, bermitra dengan Puskesmas Belakang Padang dan Kelurahan Pulau Kasu. Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan pendekatan pemberdayaan masyarakat (community empowerment) melalui empat tahap: pra-kegiatan, penyuluhan interaktif tentang epidemiologi DBD dan PSN 3M Plus, pelatihan pembuatan spray anti nyamuk metode maserasi etanol 70%, serta evaluasi pre-test/post-test menggunakan kuesioner 15 butir. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan peningkatan rata-rata skor pengetahuan peserta dari 54,7 menjadi 86,3 atau meningkat sebesar 57,8%, dan seluruh peserta berhasil memproduksi 600 mL spray herbal konsentrasi 15% dengan karakteristik organoleptis yang baik serta harga pokok produksi Rp5.000–Rp7.000 per 100 mL. Disimpulkan bahwa pemberdayaan masyarakat melalui produksi obat nyamuk herbal berbasis daun serai efektif meningkatkan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan kemandirian masyarakat pesisir dalam pencegahan DBD serta membuka peluang pengembangan UMKM warga sebagai bentuk keberlanjutan program.

Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan pendekatan pemberdayaan masyarakat (community empowerment) melalui empat tahap: pra-kegiatan, penyuluhan interaktif tentang epidemiologi DBD dan PSN 3M Plus, pelatihan pembuatan spray anti nyamuk metode maserasi etanol 70%, serta evaluasi pre-test/post-test menggunakan kuesioner 15 butir. Disimpulkan bahwa pemberdayaan masyarakat melalui produksi obat nyamuk herbal berbasis daun serai efektif meningkatkan pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan kemandirian masyarakat pesisir dalam pencegahan DBD serta membuka peluang pengembangan UMKM warga sebagai bentuk keberlanjutan program.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) remains a public health problem in Batam City, particularly in the coastal area of Pulau Kasu, due to limited access to healthcare services and high dependence on synthetic mosquito repellents containing dichlorvos and DEET, which pose risks of vector resistance and health issues.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This community service activity (PKM) was conducted on May 9, 2026, in Pulau Kasu, Batam City, targeting 30 participants consisting of PKK mothers, posyandu cadres, and Karang Taruna, in partnership with Puskesmas Belakang Padang and Kelurahan Pulau Kasu.
analysis.methods: The implementation used a community empowerment approach through four stages: pre-activity, interactive counseling on DBD epidemiology and 3M Plus PSN, training in making ethanol 70% mosquito repellent spray via maceration, and evaluation using a 15-item pre-test/post-test questionnaire.
analysis.main_results: The activity showed an average increase in participants' knowledge scores from 54.7 to 86.3, a 57.8% improvement, and all participants successfully produced 600 mL of 15% herbal spray with good organoleptic characteristics and a production cost of Rp5,000–Rp7,000 per 100 mL.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that empowering communities through herbal mosquito repellent production based on lemongrass (Cymbopogon nardus L.) effectively improved knowledge, skills, and self-reliance in DBD prevention, opening opportunities for developing community-based MSMEs as a sustainability measure.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a sustainable, low-cost alternative for DBD prevention in resource-limited areas, reducing reliance on synthetic repellents and fostering local economic development through community-based enterprises.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and short-term evaluation; however, the study demonstrates a practical, scalable approach for community-based dengue prevention in similar settings.

analysis.summary_en: This community service project addressed dengue prevention in Batam City's coastal area by empowering residents to produce herbal mosquito repellent from lemongrass. Targeting 30 participants, the program included education on dengue epidemiology and hands-on training in repellent production. Results showed a 57.8% increase in knowledge scores and successful production of affordable, effective repellent. The approach offers a sustainable alternative to synthetic chemicals, promoting both health and local economic development through community-based enterprises.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Demam Berdarah 登革热 (DBD) 仍然是巴淡市的一个公共卫生问题,特别是在卡苏岛沿海地区,因为获得医疗服务的机会有限,并且高度依赖含有敌敌畏和避蚊胺的合成驱蚊剂,这带来了 媒介 耐药性和健康问题的风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项社区服务活动(PKM)于 2026 年 5 月 9 日在巴淡岛卡苏岛开展,对象包括库尔德工人党母亲、posyandu 干部和 Karang Taruna 等 30 名参与者,与 Puskesmas Belakang Padang 和 Kelurahan Pulau Kasu 合作。
elements_zh.methods: 该实施采用社区赋权方法,分四个阶段进行:活动前、DBD 流行病学 和 3M Plus PSN 的互动咨询、通过浸渍制作 70% 乙醇驱蚊喷雾的培训,以及使用 15 项测试前/测试后问卷进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 活动显示,参与者的知识得分平均从 54.7 提高到 86.3,提高了 57.8%,所有参与者都成功生产了 600 毫升 15% 草药喷雾剂,具有良好的感官特性,每 100 毫升的生产成本为 Rp5,000–Rp7,000。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,通过以柠檬草 (Cymbopogon nardus L.) 为基础的草本驱蚊剂生产来增强社区能力,有效提高了预防 DBD 的知识、技能和自力更生,为发展基于社区的中小微企业作为可持续发展措施提供了机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为资源有限地区的 DBD 预防提供了一种可持续、低成本的替代方案,减少对合成驱虫剂的依赖,并通过社区企业促进当地经济发展。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量小、评估时间短,证据强度中等;然而,该研究展示了在类似环境下基于社区的登革热预防的实用且可扩展的方法。
